title: 廢紙脫墨處理
summary: 以「纖維解離、油墨浮選與水循環」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow fiber liberation, ink flotation and water circulation through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 進料乾纖維基準：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Dry-fiber feed basis: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 進料乾纖維基準 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Dry-fiber feed basis and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 含水廢紙質量需換成乾固體基準，否則不同批次收率不可比。
steps.instructionEn: Convert wet recovered-paper mass to dry solids for comparable yields.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：dry mass=wet mass*(1-moisture);1000*(1-0.1)；計算 1000*(1-0.1) = 900 kg。適用限制：濕基含水率。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: dry mass=wet mass*(1-moisture);1000*(1-0.1); calculation 1000*(1-0.1) = 900 kg. Applicability: Wet-basis moisture.
steps.failure: 以濕重計產率會把水分當纖維。
steps.failureEn: Wet-mass yield counts water as fiber.
steps.check: 比較含水10%與20%的同重進料。
steps.checkEn: Compare equal wet feed at10% and20% moisture.

steps.title: 碎漿濃度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Pulping consistency: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 碎漿濃度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pulping consistency and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 碎漿濃度是乾固體占漿液質量，影響混合、能耗與纖維解離。
steps.instructionEn: Consistency is dry solids over slurry mass and affects mixing, energy and fiber liberation.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：consistency=Mdry/Mslurry;900/15000；計算 900/15000 = 0.06 fraction。適用限制：質量分率，不是體積分率。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: consistency=Mdry/Mslurry;900/15000; calculation 900/15000 = 0.06 fraction. Applicability: Mass fraction, not volume fraction.
steps.failure: 將百分濃度直接代入分率公式會差100倍。
steps.failureEn: Using percent as fraction introduces a hundredfold error.
steps.check: 保持乾纖維量，增加水量比較濃度。
steps.checkEn: Keep dry fiber fixed and add water to compare consistency.

knowledge.title: 碎漿濃度
knowledge.text: 將百分濃度直接代入分率公式會差100倍。

steps.checkEn: Weigh dry froth solids and determine fiber content.

steps.title: 表面污染去除：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Surface contamination removal: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 表面污染去除 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Surface contamination removal and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 摩擦與液相傳質共同移除表面污染，去除率需以污染物質量計算，不能只看水色。

steps.objective: 辨識 浮沉分選的密度邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 浮沉依表觀密度區分，填料、氣泡與多層片會改變結果；不同聚合物也可能同浮同沉。
steps.instructionEn: Sink-float separation follows apparent density; fillers, bubbles and multilayers alter behaviour and different polymers may share a fraction.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：apparent density=mass/volume;0.095/0.0001；計算 0.095/0.0001 = 950 kg/m3。適用限制：獨立假想顆粒；水密度假設1000kg/m3。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: apparent density=mass/volume;0.095/0.0001; calculation 0.095/0.0001 = 950 kg/m3. Applicability: Isolated hypothetical particle; water assumed1000kg/m3.
steps.failure: 把漂浮物全部標成同一樹脂會漏掉材質混入。
steps.failureEn: Labelling all floating pieces as one resin misses cross-contamination.
steps.check: 先去除附著氣泡，再重測同一粒料的浮沉。
steps.checkEn: Remove adhering bubbles and repeat the same particle test.

steps.instruction: 整瓶先移除大部分異材，破碎後再按材質與顏色精選瓶片，兩段的漏選不一定獨立。
steps.instructionEn: Whole-bottle sorting removes bulk foreign material before flake material/colour sorting; misses may be correlated.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：independent residual=100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95)；計算 100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95) = 0.5 kg。適用限制：僅假設兩段獨立且同一污染群。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: independent residual=100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95); calculation 100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95) = 0.5 kg. Applicability: Assumes independent stages acting on the same contaminant population.
steps.failure: 直接相乘名目效率會忽略兩段共同看不見的異材。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying nominal efficiencies ignores contaminants missed by both.
steps.check: 用同一組難辨識異材追蹤兩段漏選是否相關。
steps.checkEn: Track difficult contaminants through both stages to test correlated misses.

steps.instruction: 去污試驗以指定替代污染物追蹤處理效果，單一容易去除的物質不能代表全部污染。

steps.failureEn: Reporting only the best removal conceals difficult contaminants.
steps.check: 逐一計算不同替代物的去除並找出限制項。
steps.checkEn: Calculate removal for each surrogate and identify the limiting case.

steps.title: 殘餘濃度的最壞情境：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Worst-case residual concentration: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 殘餘濃度的最壞情境 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Worst-case residual concentration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 以明示的初始污染假設乘殘留分率，與適用暴露模型比較；計算本身不構成食品接觸認證。
steps.instructionEn: Multiply a stated input-contamination assumption by the residual fraction and compare with the applicable exposure model; the calculation is not food-contact certification.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：residual=Cassumed*(1-removal);3*(1-0.995)；計算 3*(1-0.995) = 0.015 mg/kg。適用限制：教學初始值；不可取代法規指定情境。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: residual=Cassumed*(1-removal);3*(1-0.995); calculation 3*(1-0.995) = 0.015 mg/kg. Applicability: Teaching input value, not a regulatory scenario.
steps.failure: 四捨五入成100%去除會錯誤得到零殘餘。
steps.failureEn: Rounding removal to100% falsely produces zero residue.
steps.check: 讓去除率降低一點，觀察殘餘值的倍數變化。
steps.checkEn: Reduce removal slightly and observe the multiplicative change in residue.

steps.title: 關鍵條件偏差與批次隔離：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Critical-condition deviations and batch segregation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 關鍵條件偏差與批次隔離 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Critical-condition deviations and batch segregation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 有效去污依賴經驗證的製程條件範圍；偏差時先界定受影響物料與時間，不能靠成品外觀放行。
steps.instructionEn: Effective decontamination relies on validated process conditions; during a deviation identify affected material and time rather than releasing by appearance.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：affected mass=throughput*duration;400kg/h*15/60；計算 400*15/60 = 100 kg。適用限制：只計偏差期間進料，另需追蹤設備持料。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: affected mass=throughput*duration;400kg/h*15/60; calculation 400*15/60 = 100 kg. Applicability: Feed during deviation only; equipment hold-up also requires tracing.
steps.failure: 只隔離警報時刻的一袋會漏掉管線及反應器存料。
steps.failureEn: Isolating one bag at alarm time misses material in equipment.
steps.check: 加入設備持料量後擴大追溯範圍。
steps.checkEn: Add equipment hold-up to widen the traceability boundary.

knowledge.title: 關鍵條件偏差與批次隔離
knowledge.text: 有效去污依賴經驗證的製程條件範圍；偏差時先界定受影響物料與時間，不能靠成品外觀放行。
knowledge.textEn: Effective decontamination relies on validated process conditions; during a deviation identify affected material and time rather than releasing by appearance.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在「關鍵條件偏差與批次隔離」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 100 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只隔離警報時刻的一袋會漏掉管線及反應器存料。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
knowledge.textEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for critical-condition deviations and batch segregation, first reproduce 100 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Isolating one bag at alarm time misses material in equipment." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 成品透明就可忽略去污條件偏差。
有效去污依賴經驗證的製程條件範圍；偏差時先界定受影響物料與時間，不能靠成品外觀放行。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
optionsEn: Transparent product makes decontamination deviations irrelevant.
Effective decontamination relies on validated process conditions; during a deviation identify affected material and time rather than releasing by appearance.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
quiz.explanation: 有效去污依賴經驗證的製程條件範圍；偏差時先界定受影響物料與時間，不能靠成品外觀放行。 加入設備持料量後擴大追溯範圍。
quiz.explanationEn: Effective decontamination relies on validated process conditions; during a deviation identify affected material and time rather than releasing by appearance. Add equipment hold-up to widen the traceability boundary.

steps.title: 批次放行與證據鏈：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Batch release and evidence chain: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 批次放行與證據鏈 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Batch release and evidence chain and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 來源、分選、含水、製程紀錄與分析報告需對應同一批號；未驗證的用途應保留限制。
steps.instructionEn: Source, sorting, moisture, process records and analyses must map to the same lot; retain restrictions for unvalidated uses.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：traceable coverage=complete records/total lots;48/50；計算 48/50 = 0.96 fraction。適用限制：文件完整率不等於安全合格率。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: traceable coverage=complete records/total lots;48/50; calculation 48/50 = 0.96 fraction. Applicability: Record completeness is not a safety pass rate.
steps.failure: 用全廠平均紀錄補填缺失批次會破壞追溯。
steps.failureEn: Filling missing lot records with plant averages breaks traceability.
steps.check: 找出缺少關鍵紀錄的兩批並保持待審狀態。
steps.checkEn: Identify the two lots lacking critical records and keep them pending review.

title: 廢輪胎機械回收
summary: 以「輪胎複合材料解離、鋼絲纖維分離與膠粉品管」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow tire-composite liberation, steel/fiber separation and rubber quality through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

steps.checkEn: Compare material balances for passenger and heavy-duty tire samples.

steps.check: 對照同質量球粒與纖維的沉降觀察。
steps.checkEn: Compare settling observations for equal-mass spheres and fibers.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

title: 建築拆除材料分選
titleEn: Sorting of construction and demolition materials
summary: 以「拆除前盤點、選擇性拆解與多物料品質追蹤」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow pre-demolition inventory, selective dismantling and multi-material traceability through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

steps.title: 不確定材料的隔離分類：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 不確定材料的隔離分類 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 受管制或不明材料需先由合格程序辨識，不可混入普通回收料；教材僅模擬分類與證據管理。
steps.instructionEn: Regulated or uncertain materials need qualified identification before ordinary recycling; this lesson simulates classification and evidence management.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：verified coverage=verified locations/required locations;18/24；計算 18/24 = 0.75 fraction。適用限制：紀錄完整率，不代表剩餘材料安全。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: verified coverage=verified locations/required locations;18/24; calculation 18/24 = 0.75 fraction. Applicability: Record completeness, not safety of remaining materials.

knowledge.textEn: Gypsum and other fines can contaminate recycled minerals; separate at source and verify suitability with applicable tests.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在「石膏與細料交叉污染」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.01 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「先混後分可能讓細粉沾附所有顆粒而難以去除。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
knowledge.textEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for gypsum and fines cross-contamination, first reproduce 0.01 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Mixing first can coat particles with fines that are difficult to remove." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？

破碎後的細粉都可視為乾淨石粉。

An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
All post-crushing fines can be treated as clean mineral powder.
quiz.explanation: 石膏與其他細料可污染再生礦物料，需從源頭分流並用適用試驗確認下游用途。 比較源頭分流與混合後分選的殘留量。

steps.title: 運輸、堆置與實際密度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Transport, stockpiles and bulk density: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 運輸、堆置與實際密度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Transport, stockpiles and bulk density and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 鬆散料堆有空隙，車載體積與實體密度不可直接互換；重量及體積上限分別檢核。
steps.instructionEn: Loose stockpiles contain voids, so haul volume is not solid-material volume; check mass and volume limits separately.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：haul mass=loose volume*bulk density;12*1.4；計算 12*1.4 = 16.8 tonne。適用限制：假想鬆散密度1.4tonne/m3，非車輛載重建議。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: haul mass=loose volume*bulk density;12*1.4; calculation 12*1.4 = 16.8 tonne. Applicability: Hypothetical1.4tonne/m3 bulk density, not vehicle loading advice.
steps.failure: 使用混凝土實體密度計鬆散料會錯估車次。
steps.failureEn: Using solid concrete density for loose debris misestimates haul trips.
steps.check: 以地磅和車斗量測反算不同含水料的鬆散密度。
steps.checkEn: Infer bulk density from weighbridge and bin measurements at different moisture levels.

title: 再生混凝土骨材品管
titleEn: Quality control of recycled concrete aggregate
summary: 以「再生骨材吸水、級配、污染與混凝土試拌驗證」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow recycled-aggregate absorption, gradation, contamination and trial-mix validation through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

steps.title: 實際含水率與自由水：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Actual moisture and free water: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 實際含水率與自由水 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Actual moisture and free water and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 實際含水率高於吸水率時帶入自由水；低於吸水率時可能吸收拌合水，速率還受時間影響。
steps.instructionEn: Moisture above absorption adds free water; below absorption can absorb mixing water, with time-dependent kinetics.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：free water=Mod*(moisture-absorption);1000*(0.08-0.06)；計算 1000*(0.08-0.06) = 20 kg。適用限制：以烘乾質量為基準，假設達到所用吸水平衡。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: free water=Mod*(moisture-absorption);1000*(0.08-0.06); calculation 1000*(0.08-0.06) = 20 kg. Applicability: Oven-dry basis assuming the stated absorption equilibrium.
steps.failure: 把總含水都當自由水會少加必要拌合水。
steps.failureEn: Treating total moisture as free water under-adds mixing water.
steps.check: 將實際含水率改成4%，解釋負自由水的意義。
steps.checkEn: Change actual moisture to4% and explain negative free water.

knowledge.textEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for actual moisture and free water, first reproduce 20 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Treating total moisture as free water under-adds mixing water." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
骨材含水率8%表示全部8%都可供水泥使用。
optionsEn: Moisture above absorption adds free water; below absorption can absorb mixing water, with time-dependent kinetics.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
8% aggregate moisture means all8% is available to cement.
quiz.explanation: 實際含水率高於吸水率時帶入自由水；低於吸水率時可能吸收拌合水，速率還受時間影響。 將實際含水率改成4%，解釋負自由水的意義。
quiz.explanationEn: Moisture above absorption adds free water; below absorption can absorb mixing water, with time-dependent kinetics. Change actual moisture to4% and explain negative free water.

steps.objective: 辨識 體積置換與密度差 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Volume replacement and density difference and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 再生與天然骨材密度不同時，等質量替換會改變絕對體積與產量；應說明置換基準。
steps.instructionEn: When recycled and natural aggregate densities differ, equal-mass replacement changes absolute volume and yield; state the replacement basis.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：mass for volume=rho*V;2300*0.4；計算 2300*0.4 = 920 kg。適用限制：假想顆粒體積0.4m3與密度2300kg/m3。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: mass for volume=rho*V;2300*0.4; calculation 2300*0.4 = 920 kg. Applicability: Hypothetical0.4m3 particle volume and2300kg/m3 density.
steps.failure: 未說明質量或體積比例會讓兩組試拌不可比較。
steps.failureEn: Unstated mass/volume replacement makes trial mixes incomparable.
steps.check: 比較以質量與體積各置換同一比例的產量。
steps.checkEn: Compare yield for equal replacement percentages by mass and volume.

steps.failure: 只報總雜質會掩蓋少量但重要的特定污染。
steps.failureEn: Total impurity alone hides small but important specific contaminants.
steps.check: 把相同總量分成不同污染種類，列出所需追加試驗。
steps.checkEn: Split equal total contamination into different types and list additional tests needed.

steps.check: 比較相同養護下天然與再生骨材試體的時間曲線。

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創假想教學算例：mortar fraction=attached mortar/total;180/1000；計算 180/1000 = 0.18 fraction。適用限制：假想材料表徵，不以此單一值判定合格。
workedExample.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: mortar fraction=attached mortar/total;180/1000; calculation 180/1000 = 0.18 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical characterization; no acceptance from this value alone.

title: 污染土壤氣相抽除
summary: 本課以「用真空、氣相通量與反彈證據判讀非飽和土壤氣相抽除」為主軸，依序處理污染概念模型與非飽和帶、含水率與氣相連通、質量移除與稀釋判別、尾氣處理介質突破、觀測網與證據缺口。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Interpret unsaturated-zone vapor extraction through vacuum, gas mass flux and rebound, progressing through Conceptual site model and vadose zone, Moisture and gas connectivity, Mass removal versus dilution, Off-gas media breakthrough, Monitoring network and evidence gaps. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 污染概念模型與非飽和帶：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Conceptual site model and vadose zone: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污染概念模型與非飽和帶 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Conceptual site model and vadose zone and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先畫水位、透氣層、低滲透夾層與揮發源；氣相抽除依賴可連通的氣體孔隙，不能把飽和水體當成同一介質。 氣相孔隙體積除抽氣量是名目換氣尺度；含水增加同時會改變氣相連通性與滲透性。
steps.instructionEn: Map the water table, permeable layers, low-permeability lenses and volatile source; extraction relies on connected gas pores rather than treating saturated water identically. Air-filled pore volume divided by extraction flow gives a nominal exchange scale; rising moisture also changes connectivity and gas permeability.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：非飽和土體 V=500 m³；氣相孔隙率 na=0.20；抽氣 Q=50 m³/h。公式 t=V*na/Q，計算得 2 h。適用邊界：固定流量、均勻氣相，忽略壓縮性；不以較短名目時間推定較好整治。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Unsaturated bulk volume V=500 m³; air-filled porosity na=0.20; extraction Q=50 m³/h. Formula t=V*na/Q gives 2 h. Applicability: Fixed flow and uniform gas phase, neglecting compressibility; a shorter nominal time does not establish better remediation.
steps.failure: 水分上升可能令可抽氣孔隙變小卻加劇旁通。 在「污染概念模型與非飽和帶」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Rising moisture can reduce gas-filled pore volume while increasing bypass. Mark where this error can enter the Conceptual site model and vadose zone flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「污染概念模型與非飽和帶」，量土壤含水、各深度真空與氣體濃度，尋找被飽和水或低滲透層隔離區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Conceptual site model and vadose zone, Measure moisture, vacuum and gas concentrations by depth to locate zones isolated by water or low-permeability strata. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.text: 只將 na 改成 0.10，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變成 1 h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only air-filled porosity na to 0.10, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2 to 1 h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 分層試抽與氣量配置：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Layered pilot extraction and flow allocation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 分層試抽與氣量配置 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Layered pilot extraction and flow allocation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 逐井比較氣流和真空回應，把快速吸入地表空氣的井與穿過污染區的井區分。 抽除質量率等於氣量乘濃度；稀釋可降低濃度而沒有提高污染物移除。
steps.instructionEn: Compare well-specific flow and vacuum, separating rapid surface-air intrusion from paths through contamination. Removal mass rate equals gas flow times concentration; dilution can lower concentration without increasing removal.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽氣 Q=80 m³/h；污染物 C=25 mg/m³；同一乾濕與溫壓基準。公式 m=Q*C/1000，計算得 2 g/h。適用邊界：準穩態且基準一致，不含管路冷凝或吸附損失。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Extraction Q=80 m³/h; pollutant C=25 mg/m³ on matching moisture, temperature and pressure bases. Formula m=Q*C/1000 gives 2 g/h. Applicability: Quasi-steady conditions and consistent bases, excluding line condensation and sorption losses.
steps.failure: 只以出口濃度降低判斷進度，可能把吸入清潔空氣視為整治。 在「分層試抽與氣量配置」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Concentration decline alone may mistake clean-air intrusion for remediation. Mark where this error can enter the Layered pilot extraction and flow allocation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「分層試抽與氣量配置」，同步記錄流量及分析濃度，積分質量率並核對處理單元前後負荷。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Layered pilot extraction and flow allocation, Record flow and concentration simultaneously, integrate mass rate and reconcile loads across off-gas treatment. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 含水率與氣相連通：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Moisture and gas connectivity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 含水率與氣相連通 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Moisture and gas connectivity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在剖面上提高含水率，觀察氣相體積減少與可用路徑被截斷的不同影響。 氣相孔隙體積除抽氣量是名目換氣尺度；含水增加同時會改變氣相連通性與滲透性。
steps.instructionEn: Increase moisture in the section and distinguish loss of gas volume from interruption of connected pathways. Air-filled pore volume divided by extraction flow gives a nominal exchange scale; rising moisture also changes connectivity and gas permeability.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：非飽和土體 V=500 m³；氣相孔隙率 na=0.20；抽氣 Q=50 m³/h。公式 t=V*na/Q，計算得 2 h。適用邊界：固定流量、均勻氣相，忽略壓縮性；不以較短名目時間推定較好整治。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Unsaturated bulk volume V=500 m³; air-filled porosity na=0.20; extraction Q=50 m³/h. Formula t=V*na/Q gives 2 h. Applicability: Fixed flow and uniform gas phase, neglecting compressibility; a shorter nominal time does not establish better remediation.
steps.failure: 水分上升可能令可抽氣孔隙變小卻加劇旁通。 在「含水率與氣相連通」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Rising moisture can reduce gas-filled pore volume while increasing bypass. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture and gas connectivity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「含水率與氣相連通」，量土壤含水、各深度真空與氣體濃度，尋找被飽和水或低滲透層隔離區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Moisture and gas connectivity, Measure moisture, vacuum and gas concentrations by depth to locate zones isolated by water or low-permeability strata. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 真空抽風機與能耗：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Vacuum blower and energy demand: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 真空抽風機與能耗 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Vacuum blower and energy demand and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把井頭真空、管路阻力及處理設備壓降分開，使用工作曲線判讀氣量；高真空不必然有效覆蓋污染源。 風機軸功率近似流量乘壓升再除效率；阻力增加時不能假設風量與效率都不受影響。
steps.instructionEn: Separate well vacuum, pipe resistance and treatment pressure drop; use the working curve because strong vacuum need not cover the source. Fan shaft power is approximately flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency; increasing resistance may also change flow and efficiency.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：風量 Q=1.5 m³/s；壓升 Δp=1200 Pa；假設效率 η=0.60。公式 P=Q*dp/eta/1000，計算得 3 kW。適用邊界：不可壓縮、固定效率的比較，不是風機曲線選型。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Airflow Q=1.5 m³/s; pressure rise Δp=1200 Pa; assumed efficiency η=0.60. Formula P=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives 3 kW. Applicability: An incompressible fixed-efficiency comparison, not fan-curve selection.
steps.failure: 堵塞使壓降上升，若只提高風機轉速可能增加能耗而不解決配流。 在「真空抽風機與能耗」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Blockage raises pressure drop; speed increases may waste energy without correcting distribution. Mark where this error can enter the Vacuum blower and energy demand flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「真空抽風機與能耗」，量測風量、差壓與輸入功率，在同一運轉點核對效率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Vacuum blower and energy demand, Measure airflow, differential pressure and input power at the same operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 質量移除與稀釋判別：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Mass removal versus dilution: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 質量移除與稀釋判別 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Mass removal versus dilution and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 配對同時刻流量與濃度並積分，不以濃度單獨下降宣布整治成功。 抽除質量率等於氣量乘濃度；稀釋可降低濃度而沒有提高污染物移除。
steps.instructionEn: Pair concurrent flow and concentration and integrate removal rather than declaring success from concentration decline alone. Removal mass rate equals gas flow times concentration; dilution can lower concentration without increasing removal.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽氣 Q=80 m³/h；污染物 C=25 mg/m³；同一乾濕與溫壓基準。公式 m=Q*C/1000，計算得 2 g/h。適用邊界：準穩態且基準一致，不含管路冷凝或吸附損失。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Extraction Q=80 m³/h; pollutant C=25 mg/m³ on matching moisture, temperature and pressure bases. Formula m=Q*C/1000 gives 2 g/h. Applicability: Quasi-steady conditions and consistent bases, excluding line condensation and sorption losses.
steps.failure: 只以出口濃度降低判斷進度，可能把吸入清潔空氣視為整治。 在「質量移除與稀釋判別」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Concentration decline alone may mistake clean-air intrusion for remediation. Mark where this error can enter the Mass removal versus dilution flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「質量移除與稀釋判別」，同步記錄流量及分析濃度，積分質量率並核對處理單元前後負荷。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Mass removal versus dilution, Record flow and concentration simultaneously, integrate mass rate and reconcile loads across off-gas treatment. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 脫附控制與長期拖尾：機制與觀察

steps.instruction: 把快速抽出的氣相污染與固相緩慢釋放分開；遲滯模型是理解庫存的水土類比，不能直接當氣相分配公式。 線性平衡吸附使溶質平均遷移慢於水；吸附不是污染物破壞。

stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 尾氣處理介質突破：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Off-gas media breakthrough: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 尾氣處理介質突破 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Off-gas media breakthrough and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在數位流程加入吸附處理與前後端採樣，以介質突破和排出負荷追蹤轉移污染的去向。 容量除以污染負荷給名目耗盡時間；傳質、競爭離子及不可逆鈍化通常降低可用容量。
steps.instructionEn: Add adsorption and upstream/downstream sampling to the digital flow and follow breakthrough and discharged load to track transferred contamination. Capacity divided by load gives nominal exhaustion time; mass transfer, competition and passivation often lower usable capacity.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：介質質量 m=1000 kg；假設可用容量 a=0.02 kg/kg；污染輸入 L=0.25 kg/d。公式 t=m*a/L，計算得 80 d。適用邊界：固定負荷與已驗證可用容量，不推定真實突破日期。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Media mass m=1000 kg; assumed usable capacity a=0.02 kg/kg; pollutant loading L=0.25 kg/d. Formula t=m*a/L gives 80 d. Applicability: Constant loading and validated usable capacity; no real breakthrough date is implied.
steps.failure: 只用理論反應容量會高估介質壽命。 在「尾氣處理介質突破」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using theoretical reaction capacity alone overestimates media life. Mark where this error can enter the Off-gas media breakthrough flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「尾氣處理介質突破」，做突破曲線並記錄流量、濃度與介質狀態，將可用容量與總化學容量分開。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Off-gas media breakthrough, Measure breakthrough with flow, concentration and media condition; distinguish usable from total chemical capacity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 尾氣處理介質突破
knowledge.text: 在數位流程加入吸附處理與前後端採樣，以介質突破和排出負荷追蹤轉移污染的去向。 容量除以污染負荷給名目耗盡時間；傳質、競爭離子及不可逆鈍化通常降低可用容量。
knowledge.textEn: Add adsorption and upstream/downstream sampling to the digital flow and follow breakthrough and discharged load to track transferred contamination. Capacity divided by load gives nominal exhaustion time; mass transfer, competition and passivation often lower usable capacity.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 L 改成 0.40 kg/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 80 變成 50 d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only loading L to 0.40 kg/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 80 to 50 d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 在數位流程加入吸附處理與前後端採樣，以介質突破和排出負荷追蹤轉移污染的去向。

steps.title: 停抽與重啟反彈：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Shutdown and restart rebound: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 停抽與重啟反彈 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Shutdown and restart rebound and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 比較不同停機長度後的重啟曲線；本單元以水相濃度比作無因次示例，氣相資料也必須保持同一量測基準。 停機反彈可能反映低滲透區釋放、脫附或持續源，不等於取樣錯誤。
steps.instructionEn: Compare restart curves after different idle periods; the dimensionless example uses aqueous units and gas data likewise require matching measurement bases. Shutdown rebound may reflect low-permeability release, desorption or a continuing source, not merely sampling error.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：停機前濃度 C1=4 mg/L；重啟濃度 C2=10 mg/L。公式 rebound=C2/C1，計算得 2.5 ratio。適用邊界：同一位置與方法的濃度比；不由此比值直接辨識唯一根因。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Pre-shutdown concentration C1=4 mg/L; restart concentration C2=10 mg/L. Formula rebound=C2/C1 gives 2.5 ratio. Applicability: Concentration ratio at the same location and method; it does not identify a unique cause.
steps.failure: 只報運轉中的低濃度會掩蓋未移除的污染庫存。 在「停抽與重啟反彈」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Reporting low on-treatment values alone hides residual contaminant inventory. Mark where this error can enter the Shutdown and restart rebound flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「停抽與重啟反彈」，保留停機時間與多次重啟趨勢，對照水位、流量和空白樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Shutdown and restart rebound, Retain shutdown duration and repeated restart trends, comparing heads, flows and blanks. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 停抽與重啟反彈

knowledge.textEn: Change only restart C2 to 7 mg/L, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.5 to 1.75 ratio. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 觀測網與證據缺口：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Monitoring network and evidence gaps: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 觀測網與證據缺口 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Monitoring network and evidence gaps and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在源區、邊界和低滲透層配置教學採樣格，標出抽氣井附近以外的未驗證區域。 網格數需向上取整；空間覆蓋與熱點偵測機率是不同的採樣設計問題。
steps.instructionEn: Place teaching sample cells at the source, boundary and low-permeability zones and mark unverified areas away from extraction wells. Grid counts round upward; spatial coverage and hotspot detection probability are different sampling-design questions.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽樣區域 A=10000 m²；每格面積 a=400 m²。公式 N=ceil(A/a)，計算得 25 sample cells。適用邊界：規則平面網格計數，未指定法規採樣密度或統計信賴。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Survey area A=10000 m²; grid-cell area a=400 m². Formula N=ceil(A/a) gives 25 sample cells. Applicability: Regular planar-grid counting, not a regulatory density or statistical confidence claim.
steps.failure: 規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「觀測網與證據缺口」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Monitoring network and evidence gaps flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「觀測網與證據缺口」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Monitoring network and evidence gaps, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 階段交接與停止條件：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Phase handoff and stopping evidence: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 階段交接與停止條件 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Phase handoff and stopping evidence and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 整理捕獲、移除質量、反彈和資料有效性；設備在線率只用於交代試驗可靠性，不是清理完成指標。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。
steps.instructionEn: Combine capture, removed mass, rebound and data validity; equipment availability documents trial reliability rather than cleanup completion. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總計畫時數 T=1000 h；停機 t=60 h。公式 availability=(T-t)/T*100，計算得 94 %。適用邊界：明確定義計畫時間與停機分類；未納入性能降額或品質不合格。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.
steps.failure: 設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「階段交接與停止條件」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Phase handoff and stopping evidence flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「階段交接與停止條件」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Phase handoff and stopping evidence, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 階段交接與停止條件

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 t 改成 90 h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 94 變成 91 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only downtime to 90 h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 94 to 91 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。

optionsEn: Combine capture, removed mass, rebound and data validity; equipment availability documents trial reliability rather than cleanup completion.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

architectureNodes.label: 污染概念模型與非飽和帶
architectureNodes.labelEn: Conceptual site model and vadose zone

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：非飽和土體 V=500 m³；氣相孔隙率 na=0.20；抽氣 Q=50 m³/h。公式 t=V*na/Q，計算得 2 h。適用邊界：固定流量、均勻氣相，忽略壓縮性；不以較短名目時間推定較好整治。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Unsaturated bulk volume V=500 m³; air-filled porosity na=0.20; extraction Q=50 m³/h. Formula t=V*na/Q gives 2 h. Applicability: Fixed flow and uniform gas phase, neglecting compressibility; a shorter nominal time does not establish better remediation.

title: 地下水抽出處理
summary: 本課以「結合含水層捕獲、地上處理與污染反彈評估抽出處理」為主軸，依序處理地層、水頭與污染羽流、抽水井捕獲尺度、水量與污染負荷配對、孔隙體積與清理拖尾、停泵反彈與捕獲復核。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Evaluate pump-and-treat through aquifer capture, above-ground treatment and rebound, progressing through Stratigraphy, heads and contaminant plume, Extraction-well capture scale, Pairing water flow with contaminant load, Pore volumes and cleanup tailing, Shutdown rebound and capture review. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 地層、水頭與污染羽流：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Stratigraphy, heads and contaminant plume: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 地層、水頭與污染羽流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Stratigraphy, heads and contaminant plume and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 以同一高程基準連結觀測井，先定地下水流向，再區分溶解污染與持續污染源。 水頭差除以距離給指定方向的梯度；單一剖面不能代替三維地下水流場。
steps.instructionEn: Connect monitoring wells to one elevation datum, determine flow direction and distinguish dissolved contamination from continuing sources. Head difference over spacing gives a directional gradient; one section cannot replace a three-dimensional groundwater field.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：兩點水頭 h1=12.4 m、h2=11.8 m；距離 L=30 m。公式 i=(h1-h2)/L，計算得 0.02 m/m。適用邊界：同一標高基準、同一含水層及同步讀值。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Heads h1=12.4 m, h2=11.8 m; spacing L=30 m. Formula i=(h1-h2)/L gives 0.02 m/m. Applicability: Common elevation datum, same aquifer and synchronized readings.
steps.failure: 不同濾管深度或時間的液位可能產生假的水平梯度。 在「地層、水頭與污染羽流」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Different screen depths or measurement times can create a false horizontal gradient. Mark where this error can enter the Stratigraphy, heads and contaminant plume flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「地層、水頭與污染羽流」，測井口標高並校正液位，將多井等水頭線與地層圖共同判讀。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Stratigraphy, heads and contaminant plume, Survey reference elevations, correct water levels and interpret multiwell contours with stratigraphy. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 地下水孔隙流速：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Groundwater pore velocity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 地下水孔隙流速 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Groundwater pore velocity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將水力傳導係數、梯度與有效孔隙率逐項測定，避免把地層孔隙率直接等同可移動孔隙率。 孔隙平均流速為 Darcy 通量除有效孔隙率；污染遲滯與彌散另需處理。
steps.instructionEn: Determine conductivity, gradient and effective porosity separately rather than equating total with mobile porosity. Mean pore-water velocity is Darcy flux divided by effective porosity; retardation and dispersion require separate treatment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：K=1e-4 m/s；水力梯度 i=0.01；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25。公式 v=K*i/ne*86400，計算得 0.3456 m/d。適用邊界：飽和均質含水層、層流，非裂隙運移預測。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: K=1e-4 m/s; hydraulic gradient i=0.01; effective porosity ne=0.25. Formula v=K*i/ne*86400 gives 0.3456 m/d. Applicability: Saturated homogeneous aquifer and laminar flow; not a fractured-flow prediction.
steps.failure: 把 Darcy 通量直接當孔隙流速會低估移動速度。 在「地下水孔隙流速」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using Darcy flux directly as pore velocity understates travel speed. Mark where this error can enter the Groundwater pore velocity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「地下水孔隙流速」，將估算流速與示蹤到達、地層和水頭場比較，列出各參數範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Groundwater pore velocity, Compare estimated velocity with tracer arrival, stratigraphy and heads, listing parameter ranges. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 抽水井捕獲尺度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Extraction-well capture scale: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 抽水井捕獲尺度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Extraction-well capture scale and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 用理想截流寬度當概念起點，將污染羽流邊界疊圖，再檢查地層與補注是否破壞假設。 均勻遠場的截流寬度由抽水量與天然通量平衡估計，降深範圍與污染捕獲範圍並不相同。
steps.instructionEn: Start with ideal capture width, overlay plume boundaries and check whether stratigraphy or recharge invalidates assumptions. Far-field capture width follows pumping balanced against natural flux; a drawdown zone is not the same as a contamination capture zone.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽水 Q=100 m³/d；K=10 m/d；含水層厚 b=10 m；遠場梯度 i=0.01。公式 W=Q/(K*b*i)，計算得 100 m。適用邊界：理想穩態、均質等向性、完全貫穿單井與均勻流；僅概念尺度，非井位設計。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Pumping Q=100 m³/d; K=10 m/d; aquifer thickness b=10 m; far-field gradient i=0.01. Formula W=Q/(K*b*i) gives 100 m. Applicability: Ideal steady homogeneous isotropic aquifer, fully penetrating single well and uniform flow; a conceptual scale, not well-placement design.
steps.failure: 補注邊界、部分貫穿或異質層可使理想捕獲寬度失準。 在「抽水井捕獲尺度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Recharge boundaries, partial penetration and heterogeneity can invalidate ideal capture width. Mark where this error can enter the Extraction-well capture scale flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「抽水井捕獲尺度」，用上、下游和側向觀測井水頭、化學趨勢與流線模型交叉驗證。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Extraction-well capture scale, Cross-check upgradient, downgradient and lateral heads, chemistry and flow-path models. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 水量與污染負荷配對：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Pairing water flow with contaminant load: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 水量與污染負荷配對 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pairing water flow with contaminant load and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 用實驗室濃度對齊流量時間窗，地上處理的負荷由質量率決定而非僅看水量。 流量與濃度共同決定質量負荷；mg/L 乘 m³/d 後除以 1000 得 kg/d。
steps.instructionEn: Align laboratory concentrations with flow intervals; surface-treatment duty depends on mass rate rather than volume alone. Flow and concentration jointly determine mass loading; divide mg/L times m³/d by 1000 to obtain kg/d.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：流量 Q=120 m³/d；濃度 C=250 mg/L。公式 load=Q*C/1000，計算得 30 kg/d。適用邊界：流量與樣品代表同一時間窗；單點濃度不能代替流量加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Flow Q=120 m³/d; concentration C=250 mg/L. Formula load=Q*C/1000 gives 30 kg/d. Applicability: Flow and concentration represent the same time window; a grab value does not replace a flow-weighted mean.

steps.objective: 辨識 處理介質與突破預測 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 依污染型態選擇教學吸附流程，計算名目容量並以實際突破曲線校驗。 容量除以污染負荷給名目耗盡時間；傳質、競爭離子及不可逆鈍化通常降低可用容量。
steps.instructionEn: Select a teaching adsorption flow appropriate to the contaminant form and check nominal capacity against breakthrough. Capacity divided by load gives nominal exhaustion time; mass transfer, competition and passivation often lower usable capacity.

steps.title: 孔隙體積與清理拖尾：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Pore volumes and cleanup tailing: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 孔隙體積與清理拖尾 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pore volumes and cleanup tailing and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 計算抽水孔隙體積數後，仍檢查低滲透區擴散與吸附庫存，不以換水次數代替清理證據。 名目孔隙體積替換時間衡量通量尺度，污染物脫附與低滲透區釋放可持續更久。
steps.instructionEn: After calculating pore volumes, still inspect diffusion from low-permeability zones and sorbed inventory instead of using flushing counts as proof. Nominal pore-volume replacement measures throughput scale; desorption and low-permeability release may persist much longer.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：土體 V=1000 m³；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25；抽出流量 Q=20 m³/d。公式 tPV=V*ne/Q，計算得 12.5 d per nominal pore volume。適用邊界：均勻單一域且 ne 已知；不是整治完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Bulk volume V=1000 m³; effective porosity ne=0.25; extraction Q=20 m³/d. Formula tPV=V*ne/Q gives 12.5 d per nominal pore volume. Applicability: A homogeneous single domain with known effective porosity, not remediation completion time.
steps.failure: 優先通道可快速換水，但污染仍留在低滲透層。 在「孔隙體積與清理拖尾」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Preferential paths can replace water rapidly while contaminants remain in low-permeability layers. Mark where this error can enter the Pore volumes and cleanup tailing flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「孔隙體積與清理拖尾」，用示蹤、觀測井與抽出濃度比較捕獲範圍和拖尾，不只計算抽了幾倍孔隙水。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Pore volumes and cleanup tailing, Use tracers, monitoring wells and extracted concentrations to assess capture and tailing, not merely pore volumes pumped. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 吸附遲滯與殘留源：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Sorption retardation and residual sources: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 吸附遲滯與殘留源 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sorption retardation and residual sources and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 對比保守示蹤物與污染物的穿透曲線，理解水已更換而污染仍釋出的原因。 線性平衡吸附使溶質平均遷移慢於水；吸附不是污染物破壞。
steps.instructionEn: Compare conservative-tracer and contaminant breakthrough to explain persistent release after water replacement. Linear equilibrium sorption slows mean solute travel relative to water; sorption is not contaminant destruction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾土體積密度 ρb=1.6 kg/L；Kd=0.5 L/kg；孔隙率 n=0.30。公式 R=1+rho_b*Kd/n，計算得 3.66667 dimensionless。適用邊界：線性、可逆、即時平衡吸附及固定密度孔隙率；不適用強非線性或非平衡拖尾。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry bulk density ρb=1.6 kg/L; Kd=0.5 L/kg; porosity n=0.30. Formula R=1+rho_b*Kd/n gives 3.66667 dimensionless. Applicability: Linear reversible instantaneous equilibrium sorption with fixed density and porosity; not strongly nonlinear or nonequilibrium tailing.
steps.failure: 把高遲滯因子解讀為已除污會漏掉未來脫附。 在「吸附遲滯與殘留源」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Interpreting high retardation as cleanup overlooks later desorption. Mark where this error can enter the Sorption retardation and residual sources flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「吸附遲滯與殘留源」，用批次與柱試驗檢查 Kd 和濃度依賴性，將吸附物與溶解物總量守恆。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Sorption retardation and residual sources, Check Kd and concentration dependence in batch and column tests and balance sorbed plus dissolved mass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 停泵反彈與捕獲復核：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Shutdown rebound and capture review: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 停泵反彈與捕獲復核 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Shutdown rebound and capture review and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 只在離線情境中暫停抽水，觀察濃度回升與水頭重建；同時確認污染是否向外擴張。 停機反彈可能反映低滲透區釋放、脫附或持續源，不等於取樣錯誤。
steps.instructionEn: Pause pumping only in the offline scenario and observe concentration rebound and head recovery while checking outward plume migration. Shutdown rebound may reflect low-permeability release, desorption or a continuing source, not merely sampling error.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：停機前濃度 C1=4 mg/L；重啟濃度 C2=10 mg/L。公式 rebound=C2/C1，計算得 2.5 ratio。適用邊界：同一位置與方法的濃度比；不由此比值直接辨識唯一根因。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Pre-shutdown concentration C1=4 mg/L; restart concentration C2=10 mg/L. Formula rebound=C2/C1 gives 2.5 ratio. Applicability: Concentration ratio at the same location and method; it does not identify a unique cause.
steps.failure: 只報運轉中的低濃度會掩蓋未移除的污染庫存。 在「停泵反彈與捕獲復核」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Reporting low on-treatment values alone hides residual contaminant inventory. Mark where this error can enter the Shutdown rebound and capture review flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「停泵反彈與捕獲復核」，保留停機時間與多次重啟趨勢，對照水位、流量和空白樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Shutdown rebound and capture review, Retain shutdown duration and repeated restart trends, comparing heads, flows and blanks. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.objective: 辨識 長期策略與量測不確定度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Long-term strategy and uncertainty and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把流量與濃度的不確定度傳到移除負荷，區分真實減量、測量波動與單純稀釋。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。
steps.instructionEn: Propagate flow and concentration uncertainty into removal load to distinguish real progress from measurement variation and dilution. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
steps.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「長期策略與量測不確定度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Long-term strategy and uncertainty flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「長期策略與量測不確定度」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Long-term strategy and uncertainty, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

title: 滲透性反應牆整治
summary: 本課以「由地下水路徑、反應時間與介質老化設計反應牆教學模型」為主軸，依序處理污染羽流與牆位概念、反應介質與可用容量、柱試驗動力學、孔隙堵塞與流速變化、牆內外井網驗證。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Build a reactive-barrier teaching model from groundwater pathways, reaction time and media ageing, progressing through Plume and conceptual barrier position, Reactive medium and usable capacity, Column-test kinetics, Pore clogging and velocity change, Inside/outside monitoring network. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.title: 污染羽流與牆位概念：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Plume and conceptual barrier position: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污染羽流與牆位概念 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Plume and conceptual barrier position and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先在剖面定位羽流寬深、地下水流向和未污染旁通區，不能只在地表畫一條線稱完整截流。 孔隙平均流速為 Darcy 通量除有效孔隙率；污染遲滯與彌散另需處理。
steps.instructionEn: Locate plume width and depth, groundwater direction and bypass zones in section; a surface line alone does not establish interception. Mean pore-water velocity is Darcy flux divided by effective porosity; retardation and dispersion require separate treatment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：K=1e-4 m/s；水力梯度 i=0.01；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25。公式 v=K*i/ne*86400，計算得 0.3456 m/d。適用邊界：飽和均質含水層、層流，非裂隙運移預測。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: K=1e-4 m/s; hydraulic gradient i=0.01; effective porosity ne=0.25. Formula v=K*i/ne*86400 gives 0.3456 m/d. Applicability: Saturated homogeneous aquifer and laminar flow; not a fractured-flow prediction.
steps.failure: 把 Darcy 通量直接當孔隙流速會低估移動速度。 在「污染羽流與牆位概念」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using Darcy flux directly as pore velocity understates travel speed. Mark where this error can enter the Plume and conceptual barrier position flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「污染羽流與牆位概念」，將估算流速與示蹤到達、地層和水頭場比較，列出各參數範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Plume and conceptual barrier position, Compare estimated velocity with tracer arrival, stratigraphy and heads, listing parameter ranges. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 被動穿流與水力匹配：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Passive flow and hydraulic matching: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 被動穿流與水力匹配 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Passive flow and hydraulic matching and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 比較牆前後水頭及天然梯度，辨識污染水是穿牆、繞牆還是從牆底通過。 水頭差除以距離給指定方向的梯度；單一剖面不能代替三維地下水流場。
steps.instructionEn: Compare heads across the wall and natural gradient to distinguish through-flow from side or underflow bypass. Head difference over spacing gives a directional gradient; one section cannot replace a three-dimensional groundwater field.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：兩點水頭 h1=12.4 m、h2=11.8 m；距離 L=30 m。公式 i=(h1-h2)/L，計算得 0.02 m/m。適用邊界：同一標高基準、同一含水層及同步讀值。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Heads h1=12.4 m, h2=11.8 m; spacing L=30 m. Formula i=(h1-h2)/L gives 0.02 m/m. Applicability: Common elevation datum, same aquifer and synchronized readings.
steps.failure: 不同濾管深度或時間的液位可能產生假的水平梯度。 在「被動穿流與水力匹配」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Different screen depths or measurement times can create a false horizontal gradient. Mark where this error can enter the Passive flow and hydraulic matching flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「被動穿流與水力匹配」，測井口標高並校正液位，將多井等水頭線與地層圖共同判讀。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Passive flow and hydraulic matching, Survey reference elevations, correct water levels and interpret multiwell contours with stratigraphy. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 牆厚與接觸時間：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Wall thickness and contact time: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 牆厚與接觸時間 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Wall thickness and contact time and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 從有效孔隙率而非總體積推估接觸時間，先檢驗是否有優先通道。 反應接觸時間由孔隙水路徑與通量決定；流量增加使可用反應時間減少。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate contact time from effective pore space and first test for preferential paths. Reactive contact time depends on pore path and flux; higher flow reduces time available for reaction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：反應牆厚度 L=1.2 m；有效孔隙率 ne=0.35；Darcy 通量 q=0.07 m/d。公式 t=L*ne/q，計算得 5 d。適用邊界：均勻平面穿流、無繞流與堵塞，厚度不是設計建議。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Barrier thickness L=1.2 m; effective porosity ne=0.35; Darcy flux q=0.07 m/d. Formula t=L*ne/q gives 5 d. Applicability: Uniform planar flow with no bypass or clogging; thickness is not a design recommendation.
steps.failure: 牆體阻力增大可使污染羽流繞過，單測牆內濃度會漏判。 在「牆厚與接觸時間」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Increasing wall resistance can divert the plume; internal concentrations alone can miss bypass. Mark where this error can enter the Wall thickness and contact time flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「牆厚與接觸時間」，以柱試驗求動力學，再用上下游井與示蹤驗證是否穿越反應區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Wall thickness and contact time, Obtain kinetics from column tests, then use wells and tracers to verify passage through the reactive zone. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 柱試驗動力學：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Column-test kinetics: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 柱試驗動力學 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Column-test kinetics and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 以教學一階衰減比較不同接觸時間，量測需能區別反應和僅被介質吸附。 一階模型讓轉換速率與當下濃度成正比，對數濃度對時間近直線。
steps.instructionEn: Use teaching first-order decay to compare contact times with measurements separating reaction from temporary sorption. A first-order model makes conversion rate proportional to current concentration; log concentration is approximately linear in time.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Initial C0=100 mg/L; assumed first-order rate k=0.10 d⁻¹; time t=10 d. Formula C=C0*exp(-k*t) gives 36.7879 mg/L. steps.failure: 吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「柱試驗動力學」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。

steps.title: 反應序列與中間物：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Reaction sequence and intermediates: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 反應序列與中間物 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Reaction sequence and intermediates and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 沿流向同測母物及可能中間物；母物被轉化不保證終產物已形成。 串聯反應中間產物的累積是上游生成減下游消耗；只測母物不能判斷完整反應。
steps.instructionEn: Measure parent and potential intermediates along flow; parent conversion does not prove final-product formation. Intermediate accumulation in sequential reactions equals upstream formation minus downstream consumption; parent-only analysis cannot establish completion.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：母物轉化 n=10 mol；假設中間物化學計量 y=1 mol/mol；再降解 d=6 mol。公式 intermediate=n*y-d，計算得 4 mol。適用邊界：抽象單一路徑與已知化學計量，不指定實際污染物的毒性或現場處方。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Parent transformed n=10 mol; assumed intermediate yield y=1 mol/mol; subsequent degradation d=6 mol. Formula intermediate=n*y-d gives 4 mol. Applicability: An abstract single pathway with known stoichiometry; no real-compound toxicity or field prescription is implied.
steps.failure: 下游反應受限會在母物已下降時累積中間產物。 在「反應序列與中間物」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A downstream bottleneck accumulates intermediates even while the parent declines. Mark where this error can enter the Reaction sequence and intermediates flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「反應序列與中間物」，以莫耳量核對母物、中間物與終產物，附回收率和未量測支路。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Reaction sequence and intermediates, Reconcile parent, intermediates and products on a molar basis, including recovery and unmeasured branches. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 孔隙堵塞與流速變化：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Pore clogging and velocity change: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 孔隙堵塞與流速變化 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pore clogging and velocity change and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將礦物沉澱或生物膜造成的有效孔隙變化加入教學模型，觀察流速與接觸時間一起改變。 孔隙平均流速為 Darcy 通量除有效孔隙率；污染遲滯與彌散另需處理。
steps.instructionEn: Represent effective-pore changes from precipitation or biofilm and observe coupled velocity and residence changes. Mean pore-water velocity is Darcy flux divided by effective porosity; retardation and dispersion require separate treatment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：K=1e-4 m/s；水力梯度 i=0.01；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25。公式 v=K*i/ne*86400，計算得 0.3456 m/d。適用邊界：飽和均質含水層、層流，非裂隙運移預測。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: K=1e-4 m/s; hydraulic gradient i=0.01; effective porosity ne=0.25. Formula v=K*i/ne*86400 gives 0.3456 m/d. Applicability: Saturated homogeneous aquifer and laminar flow; not a fractured-flow prediction.
steps.failure: 把 Darcy 通量直接當孔隙流速會低估移動速度。 在「孔隙堵塞與流速變化」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using Darcy flux directly as pore velocity understates travel speed. Mark where this error can enter the Pore clogging and velocity change flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「孔隙堵塞與流速變化」，將估算流速與示蹤到達、地層和水頭場比較，列出各參數範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Pore clogging and velocity change, Compare estimated velocity with tracer arrival, stratigraphy and heads, listing parameter ranges. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 介質耗盡與負荷波動：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Media exhaustion and loading variation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 介質耗盡與負荷波動 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Media exhaustion and loading variation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 用季節流量與濃度重新估算污染通量，分開化學容量耗盡和表面鈍化。 容量除以污染負荷給名目耗盡時間；傳質、競爭離子及不可逆鈍化通常降低可用容量。
steps.instructionEn: Re-estimate load from seasonal flow and concentration and distinguish capacity exhaustion from surface passivation. Capacity divided by load gives nominal exhaustion time; mass transfer, competition and passivation often lower usable capacity.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：介質質量 m=1000 kg；假設可用容量 a=0.02 kg/kg；污染輸入 L=0.25 kg/d。公式 t=m*a/L，計算得 80 d。適用邊界：固定負荷與已驗證可用容量，不推定真實突破日期。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Media mass m=1000 kg; assumed usable capacity a=0.02 kg/kg; pollutant loading L=0.25 kg/d. Formula t=m*a/L gives 80 d. Applicability: Constant loading and validated usable capacity; no real breakthrough date is implied.
steps.failure: 只用理論反應容量會高估介質壽命。 在「介質耗盡與負荷波動」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using theoretical reaction capacity alone overestimates media life. Mark where this error can enter the Media exhaustion and loading variation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「介質耗盡與負荷波動」，做突破曲線並記錄流量、濃度與介質狀態，將可用容量與總化學容量分開。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Media exhaustion and loading variation, Measure breakthrough with flow, concentration and media condition; distinguish usable from total chemical capacity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.instruction: 整理可用容量、實際流路及季節不確定度，向下一位玩家交付需要補測的參數。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。
steps.instructionEn: Handoff usable capacity, actual pathways and seasonal uncertainty with a list of parameters needing further measurement. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：K=1e-4 m/s；水力梯度 i=0.01；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25。公式 v=K*i/ne*86400，計算得 0.3456 m/d。適用邊界：飽和均質含水層、層流，非裂隙運移預測。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: K=1e-4 m/s; hydraulic gradient i=0.01; effective porosity ne=0.25. Formula v=K*i/ne*86400 gives 0.3456 m/d. Applicability: Saturated homogeneous aquifer and laminar flow; not a fractured-flow prediction.

title: 原位生物整治
summary: 本課以「以電子收支、微生物反應與產物證據判讀原位生物整治」為主軸，依序處理污染路徑與可處理性、電子供受體收支、接觸時間與水力限制、串聯轉化與中間物累積、停止供應後的反彈。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Interpret in-situ bioremediation through electron balances, biological reactions and product evidence, progressing through Contaminant pathway and treatability, Electron donor/acceptor balance, Contact time and hydraulic constraints, Sequential transformation and intermediate buildup, Rebound after amendment cessation. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 污染路徑與可處理性：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Contaminant pathway and treatability: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污染路徑與可處理性 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Contaminant pathway and treatability and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先列污染物型態、地下水路徑與電子受供體條件，確認生物可利用性及可能產物再選情境。 線性平衡吸附使溶質平均遷移慢於水；吸附不是污染物破壞。
steps.instructionEn: List contaminant forms, groundwater paths and electron donors and acceptors; assess bioavailability and products before choosing a scenario. Linear equilibrium sorption slows mean solute travel relative to water; sorption is not contaminant destruction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾土體積密度 ρb=1.6 kg/L；Kd=0.5 L/kg；孔隙率 n=0.30。公式 R=1+rho_b*Kd/n，計算得 3.66667 dimensionless。適用邊界：線性、可逆、即時平衡吸附及固定密度孔隙率；不適用強非線性或非平衡拖尾。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry bulk density ρb=1.6 kg/L; Kd=0.5 L/kg; porosity n=0.30. Formula R=1+rho_b*Kd/n gives 3.66667 dimensionless. Applicability: Linear reversible instantaneous equilibrium sorption with fixed density and porosity; not strongly nonlinear or nonequilibrium tailing.
steps.failure: 把高遲滯因子解讀為已除污會漏掉未來脫附。 在「污染路徑與可處理性」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Interpreting high retardation as cleanup overlooks later desorption. Mark where this error can enter the Contaminant pathway and treatability flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「污染路徑與可處理性」，用批次與柱試驗檢查 Kd 和濃度依賴性，將吸附物與溶解物總量守恆。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。

steps.objective: 辨識 天然與增強生物作用 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Natural and enhanced biological activity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 以封閉資料集比較有、無生物活性對照，避免把稀釋或揮發誤當降解。 一階模型讓轉換速率與當下濃度成正比，對數濃度對時間近直線。
steps.instructionEn: Compare biologically active and inactive controls in a closed dataset to avoid mistaking dilution or volatilization for degradation. A first-order model makes conversion rate proportional to current concentration; log concentration is approximately linear in time.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Initial C0=100 mg/L; assumed first-order rate k=0.10 d⁻¹; time t=10 d. Formula C=C0*exp(-k*t) gives 36.7879 mg/L. Applicability: Constant environment and availability with no new source; this does not predict a real completion date.
steps.failure: 吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「天然與增強生物作用」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Natural and enhanced biological activity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

steps.objective: 辨識 電子供受體收支 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Electron donor/acceptor balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把污染反應和天然競爭受體分開列帳，本題只練電子當量，不提供現場投藥設定。 電子當量收支連結供體與受體；天然競爭受體及生物可利用性會改變實際需求。
steps.instructionEn: Account separately for target reactions and natural competing acceptors; this exercise teaches electron equivalents without field dosing. Electron-equivalent balance links donor and acceptor; natural competing acceptors and bioavailability change real demand.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：需移除污染物 n=20 mol；假想每 mol 需 e=4 mol 電子；供體每 mol 可提供 d=8 mol 電子。公式 donor=n*e/d，計算得 10 mol donor。適用邊界：抽象計量例，不指定現場藥劑或注入量；未含背景氧化還原需求。

steps.title: 供應物輸送與反應區：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Amendment delivery and reaction zone: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 供應物輸送與反應區 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Amendment delivery and reaction zone and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在教學含水層中比較水流速度與反應區位置，檢查供應物能否抵達受污染的低滲透部位。 孔隙平均流速為 Darcy 通量除有效孔隙率；污染遲滯與彌散另需處理。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pore velocity and reaction-zone location in the teaching aquifer, checking access to contaminated low-permeability regions. Mean pore-water velocity is Darcy flux divided by effective porosity; retardation and dispersion require separate treatment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：K=1e-4 m/s；水力梯度 i=0.01；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25。公式 v=K*i/ne*86400，計算得 0.3456 m/d。適用邊界：飽和均質含水層、層流，非裂隙運移預測。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: K=1e-4 m/s; hydraulic gradient i=0.01; effective porosity ne=0.25. Formula v=K*i/ne*86400 gives 0.3456 m/d. Applicability: Saturated homogeneous aquifer and laminar flow; not a fractured-flow prediction.
steps.failure: 把 Darcy 通量直接當孔隙流速會低估移動速度。 在「供應物輸送與反應區」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using Darcy flux directly as pore velocity understates travel speed. Mark where this error can enter the Amendment delivery and reaction zone flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「供應物輸送與反應區」，將估算流速與示蹤到達、地層和水頭場比較，列出各參數範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Amendment delivery and reaction zone, Compare estimated velocity with tracer arrival, stratigraphy and heads, listing parameter ranges. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 接觸時間與水力限制：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Contact time and hydraulic constraints: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 接觸時間與水力限制 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Contact time and hydraulic constraints and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 以孔隙替換尺度討論供應物接觸，另列混合不均和短流，不能用平均時間保證每處反應。 名目孔隙體積替換時間衡量通量尺度，污染物脫附與低滲透區釋放可持續更久。
steps.instructionEn: Use pore-volume exchange to discuss contact while separately identifying incomplete mixing and bypass. Nominal pore-volume replacement measures throughput scale; desorption and low-permeability release may persist much longer.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：土體 V=1000 m³；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25；抽出流量 Q=20 m³/d。公式 tPV=V*ne/Q，計算得 12.5 d per nominal pore volume。適用邊界：均勻單一域且 ne 已知；不是整治完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Bulk volume V=1000 m³; effective porosity ne=0.25; extraction Q=20 m³/d. Formula tPV=V*ne/Q gives 12.5 d per nominal pore volume. Applicability: A homogeneous single domain with known effective porosity, not remediation completion time.
steps.failure: 優先通道可快速換水，但污染仍留在低滲透層。 在「接觸時間與水力限制」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Preferential paths can replace water rapidly while contaminants remain in low-permeability layers. Mark where this error can enter the Contact time and hydraulic constraints flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「接觸時間與水力限制」，用示蹤、觀測井與抽出濃度比較捕獲範圍和拖尾，不只計算抽了幾倍孔隙水。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Contact time and hydraulic constraints, Use tracers, monitoring wells and extracted concentrations to assess capture and tailing, not merely pore volumes pumped. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 微生物動力學與環境依賴：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Microbial kinetics and environmental dependence: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 微生物動力學與環境依賴 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Microbial kinetics and environmental dependence and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 同一一階常數只能描述指定資料範圍；溫度、酸鹼與受體改變時需要重新驗證反應速率。 一階模型讓轉換速率與當下濃度成正比，對數濃度對時間近直線。
steps.instructionEn: A first-order constant describes only its fitted range; changes in temperature, pH or acceptors require rechecking the rate. A first-order model makes conversion rate proportional to current concentration; log concentration is approximately linear in time.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Initial C0=100 mg/L; assumed first-order rate k=0.10 d⁻¹; time t=10 d. Formula C=C0*exp(-k*t) gives 36.7879 mg/L. Applicability: Constant environment and availability with no new source; this does not predict a real completion date.
steps.failure: 吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「微生物動力學與環境依賴」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Microbial kinetics and environmental dependence flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「微生物動力學與環境依賴」，用多時點數據擬合並保留未參與擬合的點，檢查尾端是否偏離一階趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。

steps.title: 串聯轉化與中間物累積：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Sequential transformation and intermediate buildup: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 串聯轉化與中間物累積 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sequential transformation and intermediate buildup and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將母物、中間物和終產物畫成流圖，用莫耳收支確認是否卡在某一反應階段。 串聯反應中間產物的累積是上游生成減下游消耗；只測母物不能判斷完整反應。
steps.instructionEn: Draw parent, intermediate and product flows and use molar balances to identify a stalled reaction stage. Intermediate accumulation in sequential reactions equals upstream formation minus downstream consumption; parent-only analysis cannot establish completion.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：母物轉化 n=10 mol；假設中間物化學計量 y=1 mol/mol；再降解 d=6 mol。公式 intermediate=n*y-d，計算得 4 mol。適用邊界：抽象單一路徑與已知化學計量，不指定實際污染物的毒性或現場處方。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Parent transformed n=10 mol; assumed intermediate yield y=1 mol/mol; subsequent degradation d=6 mol. Formula intermediate=n*y-d gives 4 mol. Applicability: An abstract single pathway with known stoichiometry; no real-compound toxicity or field prescription is implied.
steps.failure: 下游反應受限會在母物已下降時累積中間產物。 在「串聯轉化與中間物累積」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A downstream bottleneck accumulates intermediates even while the parent declines. Mark where this error can enter the Sequential transformation and intermediate buildup flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「串聯轉化與中間物累積」，以莫耳量核對母物、中間物與終產物，附回收率和未量測支路。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Sequential transformation and intermediate buildup, Reconcile parent, intermediates and products on a molar basis, including recovery and unmeasured branches. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.instruction: 在離線模型停止假想供應，檢查殘留污染是否由吸附庫存重新釋出及產物是否持續改善。 停機反彈可能反映低滲透區釋放、脫附或持續源，不等於取樣錯誤。
steps.instructionEn: Stop hypothetical amendment in the offline model and check residual desorption and continued product improvement. Shutdown rebound may reflect low-permeability release, desorption or a continuing source, not merely sampling error.

knowledge.textEn: Stop hypothetical amendment in the offline model and check residual desorption and continued product improvement. Shutdown rebound may reflect low-permeability release, desorption or a continuing source, not merely sampling error.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 C2 改成 7 mg/L，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.5 變成 1.75 ratio。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only restart C2 to 7 mg/L, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.5 to 1.75 ratio. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
