steps.title: 多線證據與結案判讀：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Multiple lines of evidence and closure interpretation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 多線證據與結案判讀 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Multiple lines of evidence and closure interpretation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 綜合污染物、產物、電子收支和水文變化，將量測不確定度帶入反應成效而非只報母物降幅。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。
steps.instructionEn: Combine contaminants, products, electron balances and hydrology with measurement uncertainty instead of reporting parent decline alone. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
steps.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「多線證據與結案判讀」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Multiple lines of evidence and closure interpretation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「多線證據與結案判讀」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Multiple lines of evidence and closure interpretation, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

Applicability: Linear reversible instantaneous equilibrium sorption with fixed density and porosity; not strongly nonlinear or nonequilibrium tailing.

title: 工業棕地風險評估
summary: 本課以「將棕地歷史、採樣品質與暴露路徑轉為可檢查的風險概念模型」為主軸，依序處理場址使用史與概念圖、空間異質性與採樣設計、介質濃度與接觸量、地下水途徑與遷移、不確定度與決策敏感度。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Turn brownfield history, sampling quality and exposure pathways into an auditable risk model, progressing through Site history and conceptual diagram, Spatial heterogeneity and sampling design, Media concentration and contact quantity, Groundwater pathway and migration, Uncertainty and decision sensitivity. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.instruction: 在虛構工業地圖標記儲槽、裝卸、排水與回填活動，先提出可被採樣推翻的污染假說。 網格數需向上取整；空間覆蓋與熱點偵測機率是不同的採樣設計問題。

steps.title: 污染源、途徑與受體：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Source, pathway and receptor: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污染源、途徑與受體 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Source, pathway and receptor and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 為現況工人、鄰近居民與未來用途分開畫接觸路徑，未完整路徑仍需標明被切斷的依據。 介質濃度乘接觸量才形成暴露質量；受體行為與接觸路徑決定分析邊界。
steps.instructionEn: Map pathways separately for workers, neighbours and future uses, documenting evidence where a pathway is incomplete. Media concentration multiplied by contact quantity gives exposure mass; receptor behaviour and pathway define the boundary.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：土中 C=10 mg/kg；假想土壤接觸攝入量 I=50 mg/day。公式 intake=C*I/1e6，計算得 0.0005 mg/day。適用邊界：純單位換算的假想接觸例，未含生體可用率、體重或毒性；非個人健康評估。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Soil C=10 mg/kg; hypothetical soil ingestion contact I=50 mg/day. Formula intake=C*I/1e6 gives 0.0005 mg/day. Applicability: A hypothetical unit-conversion example without bioavailability, body mass or toxicity; not an individual health assessment.
steps.failure: 漏掉 mg 土壤轉 kg 的因子會產生百萬倍誤差。 在「污染源、途徑與受體」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Omitting the mg-to-kg soil conversion produces a million-fold error. Mark where this error can enter the Source, pathway and receptor flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「污染源、途徑與受體」，先畫出完整接觸路徑，再記錄接觸假設、活動時間與其依據，避免直接以濃度稱風險。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Source, pathway and receptor, Map a complete pathway before documenting contact assumptions, duration and evidence; do not call concentration alone risk. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 空間異質性與採樣設計：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Spatial heterogeneity and sampling design: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 空間異質性與採樣設計 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Spatial heterogeneity and sampling design and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 結合規則網格與設備歷史的針對性採樣，將熱點調查與區域平均估計分成不同任務。 網格數需向上取整；空間覆蓋與熱點偵測機率是不同的採樣設計問題。
steps.instructionEn: Combine grids with historically targeted samples and separate hotspot investigation from area-mean estimation. Grid counts round upward; spatial coverage and hotspot detection probability are different sampling-design questions.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽樣區域 A=10000 m²；每格面積 a=400 m²。公式 N=ceil(A/a)，計算得 25 sample cells。適用邊界：規則平面網格計數，未指定法規採樣密度或統計信賴。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Survey area A=10000 m²; grid-cell area a=400 m². Formula N=ceil(A/a) gives 25 sample cells. Applicability: Regular planar-grid counting, not a regulatory density or statistical confidence claim.
steps.failure: 規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「空間異質性與採樣設計」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Spatial heterogeneity and sampling design flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「空間異質性與採樣設計」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Spatial heterogeneity and sampling design, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 空間異質性與採樣設計

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 a 改成 300 m²，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 25 變成 34 sample cells。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only cell area a to 300 m², holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 25 to 34 sample cells. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？

options: 樣本平均值低就代表每個未採樣位置也都低。
結合規則網格與設備歷史的針對性採樣，將熱點調查與區域平均估計分成不同任務。

optionsEn: A low sample mean proves every unsampled location is also low.

An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.

quiz.explanationEn: Combine grids with historically targeted samples and separate hotspot investigation from area-mean estimation. steps.title: 實驗室品質與平行樣：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Laboratory assurance and duplicates: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 實驗室品質與平行樣 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Laboratory assurance and duplicates and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 查核空白、保存時間、回收率和重複性，未達量測目的的資料需保留旗標。 平行樣相對百分差衡量重複性，不能單獨揭露共同系統偏差或整個場址異質性。
steps.instructionEn: Check blanks, holding records, recovery and precision and flag data that do not meet the measurement objective. Relative percent difference measures duplicate precision but cannot alone reveal shared systematic bias or site-wide heterogeneity.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：平行樣 C1=18 mg/kg；C2=22 mg/kg。公式 RPD=abs(C1-C2)/((C1+C2)/2)*100，計算得 20 %。適用邊界：同基準且高於定量能力的正值；近零時比例不穩，無預設法定合格門檻。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Duplicate C1=18 mg/kg; C2=22 mg/kg. Formula RPD=abs(C1-C2)/((C1+C2)/2)*100 gives 20 %. Applicability: Positive values on the same basis above quantification capability; ratios become unstable near zero, with no assumed legal acceptance threshold.
steps.failure: 兩樣同受污染或同一校正偏差時，RPD 仍可很低。 在「實驗室品質與平行樣」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Two equally contaminated or equally miscalibrated samples can have a low RPD. Mark where this error can enter the Laboratory assurance and duplicates flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「實驗室品質與平行樣」，搭配空白、加標回收和採樣位置檢查差異來自分析或現場不均。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Laboratory assurance and duplicates, Combine blanks, spikes and sample locations to separate analytical variation from field heterogeneity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 介質濃度與接觸量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Media concentration and contact quantity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 介質濃度與接觸量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Media concentration and contact quantity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 逐項追蹤介質單位和接觸行為，避免將 mg/kg 土壤與 mg/kg 體重混為一談。 介質濃度乘接觸量才形成暴露質量；受體行為與接觸路徑決定分析邊界。
steps.instructionEn: Track media units and contact assumptions carefully and distinguish mg/kg soil from mg/kg body mass. Media concentration multiplied by contact quantity gives exposure mass; receptor behaviour and pathway define the boundary.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：土中 C=10 mg/kg；假想土壤接觸攝入量 I=50 mg/day。公式 intake=C*I/1e6，計算得 0.0005 mg/day。適用邊界：純單位換算的假想接觸例，未含生體可用率、體重或毒性；非個人健康評估。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Soil C=10 mg/kg; hypothetical soil ingestion contact I=50 mg/day. Formula intake=C*I/1e6 gives 0.0005 mg/day. Applicability: A hypothetical unit-conversion example without bioavailability, body mass or toxicity; not an individual health assessment.
steps.failure: 漏掉 mg 土壤轉 kg 的因子會產生百萬倍誤差。 在「介質濃度與接觸量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Omitting the mg-to-kg soil conversion produces a million-fold error. Mark where this error can enter the Media concentration and contact quantity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「介質濃度與接觸量」，先畫出完整接觸路徑，再記錄接觸假設、活動時間與其依據，避免直接以濃度稱風險。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。

steps.title: 地下水途徑與遷移：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Groundwater pathway and migration: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 地下水途徑與遷移 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Groundwater pathway and migration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把源區與下游受體連結，加入地下水流速、吸附和不確定流路，避免用直線距離當抵達時間。 孔隙平均流速為 Darcy 通量除有效孔隙率；污染遲滯與彌散另需處理。
steps.instructionEn: Connect sources with downgradient receptors while accounting for velocity, sorption and uncertain paths rather than distance alone. Mean pore-water velocity is Darcy flux divided by effective porosity; retardation and dispersion require separate treatment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：K=1e-4 m/s；水力梯度 i=0.01；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25。公式 v=K*i/ne*86400，計算得 0.3456 m/d。適用邊界：飽和均質含水層、層流，非裂隙運移預測。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: K=1e-4 m/s; hydraulic gradient i=0.01; effective porosity ne=0.25. Formula v=K*i/ne*86400 gives 0.3456 m/d. Applicability: Saturated homogeneous aquifer and laminar flow; not a fractured-flow prediction.
steps.failure: 把 Darcy 通量直接當孔隙流速會低估移動速度。 在「地下水途徑與遷移」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。

steps.title: 不確定度與決策敏感度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Uncertainty and decision sensitivity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 不確定度與決策敏感度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Uncertainty and decision sensitivity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 對流量與濃度等量測建立不確定度示例，另外列出模型結構和未採樣熱點的不確定性。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。
steps.instructionEn: Build an uncertainty example for flow and concentration while separately listing structural and unsampled-hotspot uncertainty. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
steps.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「不確定度與決策敏感度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Uncertainty and decision sensitivity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「不確定度與決策敏感度」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Uncertainty and decision sensitivity, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

title: 連續排放監測系統
summary: 本課以「把取樣、校正、氣體基準與品質旗標串成可信的連續排放資料」為主軸，依序處理量測目的與取樣代表性、水分與乾濕基換算、參考氧濃度校正、與獨立參考法比較、有效資料與缺測旗標。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Link sampling, calibration, gas bases and quality flags into credible continuous emission data, progressing through Measurement objective and sample representativeness, Moisture and wet/dry conversion, Reference-oxygen correction, Comparison with an independent reference, Valid data and missing-value flags. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.objective: 辨識 取樣管與全系統延遲 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sampling line and whole-system lag and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把探頭、加熱管、調理器和分析儀畫成流程，分清資料時間與樣本離開煙道的時間。 輸送延遲會把監測訊號與製程事件錯開，分析前須對齊時間。
steps.instructionEn: Map probe, heated line, conditioner and analyzer and distinguish recorded time from the time the sample left the stack. Transport delay shifts monitoring signals relative to process events; align time before interpretation.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：取樣管容積 V=2 L；流量 q=0.5 L/min。公式 t=V/q，計算得 4 min。適用邊界：理想置換延遲，未含混合、吸附與分析儀響應時間。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Sampling-line volume V=2 L; flow q=0.5 L/min. Formula t=V/q gives 4 min. Applicability: Ideal displacement delay without mixing, adsorption or analyzer response time.

steps.checkEn: For Sampling line and whole-system lag, Use a safe reference signal or offline pulse replay to measure whole-system response, not analyzer specifications alone. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 水分與乾濕基換算：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Moisture and wet/dry conversion: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 水分與乾濕基換算 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Moisture and wet/dry conversion and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 保留樣本含濕與調理方式，檢查可溶性物種是否在冷凝過程流失。 移除水蒸氣後同量污染物對應較小乾氣體積，因此乾基濃度高於濕基。
steps.instructionEn: Retain moisture and conditioning method and check whether soluble species are lost during condensation. Removing water vapour leaves the same pollutant in a smaller dry-gas volume, so dry concentration exceeds wet concentration.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕基 Cw=40 mg/m³；水蒸氣體積分率 H=0.10。公式 Cd=Cw/(1-H)，計算得 44.4444 mg per dry m³。適用邊界：理想氣體且前後溫壓基準一致，未考慮污染物溶入冷凝水。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet concentration Cw=40 mg/m³; water-vapour volume fraction H=0.10. Formula Cd=Cw/(1-H) gives 44.4444 mg per dry m³. Applicability: Ideal gas with matching temperature and pressure bases, excluding pollutant dissolution in condensate.
steps.failure: 把已乾燥的訊號再作乾基校正會重複放大濃度。 在「水分與乾濕基換算」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Applying dry correction again to an already dry measurement double-increases concentration. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture and wet/dry conversion flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「水分與乾濕基換算」，保留含濕量與氣體基準，檢查取樣調理是否同時移除可溶性污染物。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Moisture and wet/dry conversion, Retain moisture and gas bases and check whether sample conditioning also removes soluble pollutants. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 參考氧濃度校正：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Reference-oxygen correction: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 參考氧濃度校正 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Reference-oxygen correction and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 對需要的報告項才套用適用參考氧值，保留原始乾基濃度並防止重複校正。 氧校正比較固定參考氧濃度下的稀釋程度，不能與乾濕基校正混為一項。
steps.instructionEn: Apply an applicable reference oxygen only to report items requiring it, retain raw dry concentration and prevent duplicate correction. Oxygen correction normalizes dilution to a reference oxygen concentration and is separate from moisture correction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾基濃度 C=50 mg/Nm³；量測 O₂=10%；假想參考 O₂ref=11%。公式 Cref=C*(21-O2ref)/(21-O2)，計算得 45.4545 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference。適用邊界：以 21% 空氣氧近似且氧測值遠低於 21%；參考值僅為算例，不聲稱適用法規。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry concentration C=50 mg/Nm³; measured O₂=10%; hypothetical reference O₂ref=11%. Formula Cref=C*(21-O2ref)/(21-O2) gives 45.4545 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference. Applicability: Approximate air oxygen at 21%, with measured oxygen well below it; the reference is illustrative, not a legal claim.
steps.failure: 接近空氣氧含量時分母很小，微小氧誤差會放大。 在「參考氧濃度校正」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。

steps.check: 針對「參考氧濃度校正」，保存原始濃度、含濕與 O₂，再重算每項校正，防止對已校正數據重複校正。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。

steps.title: 與獨立參考法比較：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Comparison with an independent reference: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 與獨立參考法比較 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Comparison with an independent reference and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 使用未參與校正的參考資料查核殘差，檢查全系統誤差而非只驗分析儀。 零點誤差與斜率誤差對不同濃度的影響不同，單點校正不能分開識別兩者。
steps.instructionEn: Check residuals with independent reference data excluded from calibration and assess the full system rather than the analyzer alone. Offset and slope errors affect different concentrations differently; a single calibration point cannot identify both.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：參考濃度 C=50；儀器響應 y=1.08*C+2。公式 bias=y-C，計算得 6 concentration units。適用邊界：假想線性響應，濃度單位前後一致；不外推至非線性量程。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Reference concentration C=50; instrument response y=1.08*C+2. Formula bias=y-C gives 6 concentration units. Applicability: Hypothetical linear response with common concentration units; do not extrapolate into nonlinear ranges.
steps.failure: 只修正零點會留下隨濃度增加的斜率偏差。 在「與獨立參考法比較」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Correcting offset alone leaves concentration-dependent slope error. Mark where this error can enter the Comparison with an independent reference flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「與獨立參考法比較」，用空白及至少兩個非零參考點檢查殘差，保留獨立查核樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Comparison with an independent reference, Use blanks and at least two nonzero references to inspect residuals, retaining an independent check standard. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 與獨立參考法比較

steps.instruction: 濃度與流量共用溫壓訊號時可能相關，先檢查共變異才使用獨立誤差近似。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。

steps.checkEn: For Load uncertainty budget, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 uC 改成 0.03，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072111 變成 0.05 relative standard uncertainty。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。

steps.title: 有效資料與缺測旗標：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Valid data and missing-value flags: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 有效資料與缺測旗標 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Valid data and missing-value flags and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將校正、維護、異常及通訊斷線分開標記，缺值絕不能直接當作零排放。 完整率追蹤有效資料覆蓋；缺值可能集中在尖峰事件，不能只看比例。
steps.instructionEn: Flag calibration, maintenance, faults and communication loss separately and never treat missing values as zero emissions. Completeness tracks valid coverage; gaps may cluster during peaks, so percentage alone is insufficient.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：應有時段 N=1440；有效時段 n=1320。公式 coverage=n/N*100，計算得 91.6667 %。適用邊界：明確時間格與有效性規則；本題不宣稱任何法規有效率門檻。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Expected intervals N=1440; valid intervals n=1320. Formula coverage=n/N*100 gives 91.6667 %. Applicability: Explicit interval grid and validity rules; no regulatory completeness threshold is claimed.
steps.failure: 高污染時停機造成選擇性缺值，可偏低估平均污染。 在「有效資料與缺測旗標」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Outages during high pollution cause selective missingness and can bias the average downward. Mark where this error can enter the Valid data and missing-value flags flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「有效資料與缺測旗標」，畫出缺值時間軸並保留校正、維護與通訊錯誤旗標，禁止把缺值填成零。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Valid data and missing-value flags, Plot missing intervals with calibration, maintenance and communication flags; never replace missing values with zero. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

workedExample.text: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：應有時段 N=1440；有效時段 n=1320。公式 coverage=n/N*100，計算得 91.6667 %。適用邊界：明確時間格與有效性規則；本題不宣稱任何法規有效率門檻。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Expected intervals N=1440; valid intervals n=1320. Formula coverage=n/N*100 gives 91.6667 %. Applicability: Explicit interval grid and validity rules; no regulatory completeness threshold is claimed.

title: 都市空氣品質感測網
summary: 本課以「以共置驗證、空間代表性與資料品質建立都市空氣感測網」為主軸，依序處理設站問題與空間尺度、響應曲線與校正集、平均偏差與誤差抵銷、缺值、離線與異常旗標、漂移與定期再共置。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Build an urban air-sensor network through colocation, spatial representativeness and data quality, progressing through Siting question and spatial scale, Response curve and calibration dataset, Mean bias and error cancellation, Gaps, offline periods and outlier flags, Drift and repeat colocation. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 設站問題與空間尺度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Siting question and spatial scale: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 設站問題與空間尺度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Siting question and spatial scale and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先選交通、背景或社區比較目的，再配置站點；名目站距不能代表街谷中的污染梯度。 平均面積平方根給名目站距，不能代表街谷或污染源周邊的實際解析度。
steps.instructionEn: Choose traffic, background or community-comparison objectives before siting; nominal spacing does not resolve street-canyon gradients. Square root of mean area per station gives nominal spacing, not actual resolution near street canyons or sources.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：都市面積 A=36 km²；感測站 N=16。公式 s=sqrt(A/N)，計算得 1.5 km nominal spacing。適用邊界：均勻平面方格的幾何近似，不是採樣密度或法定設站建議。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Urban area A=36 km²; number of sensors N=16. Formula s=sqrt(A/N) gives 1.5 km nominal spacing. Applicability: A geometric approximation to a uniform square grid, not a station-density or regulatory siting recommendation.
steps.failure: 站點集中於供電方便處會留下系統性盲區。 在「設站問題與空間尺度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Clustering stations where power is convenient creates systematic blind spots. Mark where this error can enter the Siting question and spatial scale flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「設站問題與空間尺度」，將站點疊在道路、地形與使用目的圖，檢查空間缺口及重複代表區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Siting question and spatial scale, Overlay stations on roads, terrain and measurement objectives and check gaps and redundant representation. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 共置與時間對齊：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Colocation and time alignment: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 共置與時間對齊 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Colocation and time alignment and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將感測器與參考儀放在可比較的位置和時段，保留時鐘、平均窗與進氣高度差異。 平均誤差描述方向性偏差；正負誤差可抵銷，因此需另報散布或 RMSE。
steps.instructionEn: Colocate sensors and references comparably and retain differences in clock, averaging interval and inlet height. Mean error describes directional bias; positive and negative errors can cancel, so also report spread or RMSE.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：三個誤差值 e=[2, -1, 3] µg/m³。公式 bias=mean(e)，計算得 1.33333 µg/m³。適用邊界：配對的同時同地資料，未由三點推定完整長期性能。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Three errors e=[2, -1, 3] µg/m³. Formula bias=mean(e) gives 1.33333 µg/m³. Applicability: Paired colocated, concurrent observations; three points do not establish long-term performance.
steps.failure: 平均偏差接近零仍可能有很大的正負誤差。 在「共置與時間對齊」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Near-zero mean bias can coexist with large positive and negative errors. Mark where this error can enter the Colocation and time alignment flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「共置與時間對齊」，繪製誤差對濃度、濕度和時間圖，分開檢查偏差與變異。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Colocation and time alignment, Plot errors against concentration, humidity and time, examining bias separately from variability. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.instruction: 校正資料要涵蓋預期濃度範圍，分開訓練、驗證與外部測試，避免把擬合成績當泛化能力。 零點誤差與斜率誤差對不同濃度的影響不同，單點校正不能分開識別兩者。
steps.instructionEn: Cover the expected concentration range and separate training, validation and external testing rather than equating fit with generalization. Offset and slope errors affect different concentrations differently; a single calibration point cannot identify both.

steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Reference concentration C=50; instrument response y=1.08*C+2. Formula bias=y-C gives 6 concentration units. steps.title: 平均偏差與誤差抵銷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Mean bias and error cancellation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 平均偏差與誤差抵銷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Mean bias and error cancellation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把高低濃度時的誤差分開畫圖；整體平均誤差接近零可能掩蓋兩端相反偏差。 平均誤差描述方向性偏差；正負誤差可抵銷，因此需另報散布或 RMSE。
steps.instructionEn: Plot errors separately at low and high concentrations because near-zero overall bias can conceal opposite endpoint errors. Mean error describes directional bias; positive and negative errors can cancel, so also report spread or RMSE.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：三個誤差值 e=[2, -1, 3] µg/m³。公式 bias=mean(e)，計算得 1.33333 µg/m³。適用邊界：配對的同時同地資料，未由三點推定完整長期性能。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Three errors e=[2, -1, 3] µg/m³. Formula bias=mean(e) gives 1.33333 µg/m³. Applicability: Paired colocated, concurrent observations; three points do not establish long-term performance.
steps.failure: 平均偏差接近零仍可能有很大的正負誤差。 在「平均偏差與誤差抵銷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Near-zero mean bias can coexist with large positive and negative errors. Mark where this error can enter the Mean bias and error cancellation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「平均偏差與誤差抵銷」，繪製誤差對濃度、濕度和時間圖，分開檢查偏差與變異。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Mean bias and error cancellation, Plot errors against concentration, humidity and time, examining bias separately from variability. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: RMSE 與保留資料驗證：機制與觀察

steps.objective: 辨識 RMSE 與保留資料驗證 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of RMSE and held-out validation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 以未參與擬合的配對資料計算誤差，並同時報斜率、偏差和季節覆蓋。 RMSE 先平方再平均開根號，同時反映偏差與散布，不是標準差的同義詞。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate error on held-out paired data and also report slope, bias and seasonal coverage. RMSE squares errors before averaging and taking the root; it includes bias and spread and is not synonymous with standard deviation.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：三個配對誤差 e=[2,-1,3] µg/m³。公式 RMSE=sqrt(mean(e²))，計算得 2.16025 µg/m³。適用邊界：配對樣本與相同單位；不由 RMSE 單獨判斷用途適合度。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Three paired errors e=[2,-1,3] µg/m³. Formula RMSE=sqrt(mean(e²)) gives 2.16025 µg/m³. Applicability: Paired samples in the same units; RMSE alone does not establish fitness for purpose.

steps.checkEn: For RMSE and held-out validation, Report it with mean bias, slope and residual plots and evaluate on held-out data. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 地圖插值與代表範圍：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Mapping interpolation and representation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 地圖插值與代表範圍 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Mapping interpolation and representation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 圖上標出站位、空白區與不確定範圍，避免把平滑插值視為每條街的實測值。 平均面積平方根給名目站距，不能代表街谷或污染源周邊的實際解析度。
steps.instructionEn: Show sites, unsampled areas and uncertainty on maps rather than presenting smooth interpolation as direct measurement on every street. Square root of mean area per station gives nominal spacing, not actual resolution near street canyons or sources.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：都市面積 A=36 km²；感測站 N=16。公式 s=sqrt(A/N)，計算得 1.5 km nominal spacing。適用邊界：均勻平面方格的幾何近似，不是採樣密度或法定設站建議。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Urban area A=36 km²; number of sensors N=16. Formula s=sqrt(A/N) gives 1.5 km nominal spacing. Applicability: A geometric approximation to a uniform square grid, not a station-density or regulatory siting recommendation.
steps.failure: 站點集中於供電方便處會留下系統性盲區。 在「地圖插值與代表範圍」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Drift and repeat colocation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 比較感測器老化前後的保留測試資料；維修或更換之後保留版本資訊以避免拼接偏差。 RMSE 先平方再平均開根號，同時反映偏差與散布，不是標準差的同義詞。
steps.instructionEn: Compare held-out tests before and after ageing and retain versions after maintenance or replacement to avoid splicing bias. RMSE squares errors before averaging and taking the root; it includes bias and spread and is not synonymous with standard deviation.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：三個配對誤差 e=[2,-1,3] µg/m³。公式 RMSE=sqrt(mean(e²))，計算得 2.16025 µg/m³。適用邊界：配對樣本與相同單位；不由 RMSE 單獨判斷用途適合度。

title: 環境噪音屏障設計
summary: 本課以「從聲能、頻率與繞射幾何到屏障插入損失驗證」為主軸，依序處理聲源盤查與分貝加總、距離衰減與聲源幾何、頂部繞射與路徑差、板材穿透與開口漏聲、背景聲與效果上限。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Connect acoustic energy, frequency and diffraction geometry with verified barrier insertion loss, progressing through Source inventory and decibel addition, Distance loss and source geometry, Top-edge diffraction and path difference, Panel transmission and opening leakage, Background sound and performance floor. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.title: 聲源盤查與分貝加總：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Source inventory and decibel addition: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 聲源盤查與分貝加總 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Source inventory and decibel addition and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在道路與設備場景分離多個不相關音源，先轉線性能量再加總，保留頻帶與加權方式。 分貝是對數量，需先加線性能量；相干音源和相位干涉需另處理。
steps.instructionEn: Separate uncorrelated road and equipment sources, add linear energies and preserve frequency bands and weighting. Decibels are logarithmic, so add linear energies first; coherent sources and phase interference require separate treatment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：兩個互不相關聲源 L1=60 dB、L2=60 dB。公式 L=10*log10(10^(L1/10)+10^(L2/10))，計算得 63.0103 dB。適用邊界：相同頻帶、時間與加權的互不相關聲源。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Two uncorrelated sources L1=60 dB, L2=60 dB. Formula L=10*log10(10^(L1/10)+10^(L2/10)) gives 63.0103 dB. Applicability: Uncorrelated sources with the same band, duration and weighting.
steps.failure: 直接相加 dB 會嚴重高估總噪音。 在「聲源盤查與分貝加總」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Adding dB arithmetically severely overstates combined sound. Mark where this error can enter the Source inventory and decibel addition flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「聲源盤查與分貝加總」，保持量測位置和背景條件一致，分別量聲源與合成聲，記錄頻譜。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Source inventory and decibel addition, Keep position and background consistent, measure separate and combined sources, and retain spectra. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 基線聲級與時間尺度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Baseline level and time scale: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 基線聲級與時間尺度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Baseline level and time scale and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把交通尖峰和離峰按實際時長合併，不使用聲級數值的算術平均。 等效聲級是能量隨時間的平均，短時高聲級可能主導結果。
steps.instructionEn: Combine peak and off-peak traffic using actual durations rather than arithmetic averaging of decibel levels. Equivalent level is a time average of acoustic energy; short high-level periods can dominate.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：時段一 L1=70 dB、t1=1 h；時段二 L2=60 dB、t2=3 h。公式 Leq=10*log10((t1*10^(L1/10)+t2*10^(L2/10))/(t1+t2))，計算得 65.1188 dB。適用邊界：同一聲學加權、無重複時段；不是 dB 數值的算術平均。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Interval one L1=70 dB, t1=1 h; interval two L2=60 dB, t2=3 h. Formula Leq=10*log10((t1*10^(L1/10)+t2*10^(L2/10))/(t1+t2)) gives 65.1188 dB. Applicability: Common weighting with nonoverlapping intervals; not an arithmetic dB average.
steps.failure: 把每個時段視為等長會偏誤整段評估。 在「基線聲級與時間尺度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Treating intervals of different duration as equal biases the assessment. Mark where this error can enter the Baseline level and time scale flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「基線聲級與時間尺度」，保留時段長度與完整聲級記錄，對齊交通或設備運轉事件。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Baseline level and time scale, Retain durations and full level records, aligned with traffic or equipment events. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 距離衰減與聲源幾何：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Distance loss and source geometry: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 距離衰減與聲源幾何 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Distance loss and source geometry and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 用孤立設備的點源例建立概念，接著指出長道路是延伸聲源，不能直接沿用點源尺度。 球面擴散令強度按距離平方降低；線聲源、公路與反射環境不能直接套相同衰減。
steps.instructionEn: Develop intuition with an isolated point-source machine, then identify a long road as an extended source requiring different scaling. Spherical spreading reduces intensity with distance squared; line sources, highways and reflective environments need different treatment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：自由場點音源參考距離 r1=10 m；接收距離 r2=20 m。公式 deltaL=20*log10(r2/r1)，計算得 6.0206 dB reduction。適用邊界：無反射、無屏障、遠場點源；僅為與屏障作用比較的基線。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Free-field point-source reference distance r1=10 m; receiver distance r2=20 m. Formula deltaL=20*log10(r2/r1) gives 6.0206 dB reduction. Applicability: Unobstructed reflection-free far-field point source; a baseline for comparison with barriers only.
steps.failure: 把長道路當孤立點音源會高估距離衰減。 在「距離衰減與聲源幾何」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Treating a long road as one point source overstates distance attenuation. Mark where this error can enter the Distance loss and source geometry flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「距離衰減與聲源幾何」，確認聲源幾何與背景聲，沿多距離點量測並檢查是否符合點源假設。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Distance loss and source geometry, Check source geometry and background and measure at multiple distances to test point-source assumptions. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 板材穿透與開口漏聲：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Panel transmission and opening leakage: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 板材穿透與開口漏聲 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Panel transmission and opening leakage and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在理想板面加入接縫與開口，觀察能量穿透率的面積加權；同時保留繞射造成的另一條路。 平行穿透路徑的能量按面積加權，少量無阻隔開口即可主導穿透。
steps.instructionEn: Add joints and openings to an ideal panel and examine area-weighted transmission while retaining diffraction as a separate path. Energy through parallel transmission paths is area weighted; small unblocked openings can dominate transmission.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總面積 A=100 m²；開口 Ag=1 m²；板材能量穿透率 τp=0.001；開口 τg=1。公式 TL=-10*log10(((A-Ag)*tau_p+Ag*tau_g)/A)，計算得 19.59 dB composite transmission loss。適用邊界：均勻入射的理想面積平均，不含繞射與反射；此穿透損失不同於現地插入損失。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Total area A=100 m²; opening Ag=1 m²; panel energy transmission τp=0.001; opening τg=1. Formula TL=-10*log10(((A-Ag)*tau_p+Ag*tau_g)/A) gives 19.59 dB composite transmission loss. Applicability: Ideal area averaging under uniform incidence, excluding diffraction and reflection; transmission loss differs from field insertion loss.
steps.failure: 只採用板材實驗室數據會忽略現地開口造成的漏聲。 在「板材穿透與開口漏聲」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Panel laboratory data alone overlooks field openings and leakage. Mark where this error can enter the Panel transmission and opening leakage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「板材穿透與開口漏聲」，檢查門縫、排水孔與板間接縫，將透射與繞射分開建模。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Panel transmission and opening leakage, Inspect door gaps, drains and joints and model transmission separately from diffraction. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 現地插入損失：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Field insertion loss: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 現地插入損失 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Field insertion loss and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 屏障前後都用同一接收點並用參考麥克風校正聲源差異，將天氣變化列入紀錄。 插入損失比較同一接收點與相同聲源、氣象基準的前後差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the same receiver before and after, a reference microphone for source changes and a weather record. Insertion loss compares before and after at the same receiver with matched source and meteorological conditions.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：同條件屏障前 Lbefore=72 dB；屏障後 Lafter=64 dB。公式 IL=Lbefore-Lafter，計算得 8 dB。適用邊界：背景、交通量與量測條件已匹配；不是聲壓振幅百分比。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Matched before-barrier level Lbefore=72 dB; after level Lafter=64 dB. Formula IL=Lbefore-Lafter gives 8 dB. Applicability: Matched background, traffic and measurement conditions; this is not a pressure-amplitude percentage.
steps.failure: 車流減少造成的下降可能被錯歸因於屏障。 在「現地插入損失」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A traffic decrease may be wrongly credited to the barrier. Mark where this error can enter the Field insertion loss flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「現地插入損失」，加入參考麥克風校正聲源變動，記錄車流、風向與頻帶。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Field insertion loss, Use a reference microphone to correct source variation and record traffic, wind and frequency bands. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Background sound and performance floor and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 當目標聲源降低後，未被屏障遮住的背景聲可能主導總聲級，不能期待總值無限制下降。 分貝是對數量，需先加線性能量；相干音源和相位干涉需另處理。
steps.instructionEn: As the target source falls, unshielded background may dominate the total and limit observed improvement. Decibels are logarithmic, so add linear energies first; coherent sources and phase interference require separate treatment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：兩個互不相關聲源 L1=60 dB、L2=60 dB。公式 L=10*log10(10^(L1/10)+10^(L2/10))，計算得 63.0103 dB。適用邊界：相同頻帶、時間與加權的互不相關聲源。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Two uncorrelated sources L1=60 dB, L2=60 dB. Formula L=10*log10(10^(L1/10)+10^(L2/10)) gives 63.0103 dB. Applicability: Uncorrelated sources with the same band, duration and weighting.
steps.failure: 直接相加 dB 會嚴重高估總噪音。 在「背景聲與效果上限」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。

steps.checkEn: For Background sound and performance floor, Keep position and background consistent, measure separate and combined sources, and retain spectra. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：兩個互不相關聲源 L1=60 dB、L2=60 dB。公式 L=10*log10(10^(L1/10)+10^(L2/10))，計算得 63.0103 dB。適用邊界：相同頻帶、時間與加權的互不相關聲源。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Two uncorrelated sources L1=60 dB, L2=60 dB. Formula L=10*log10(10^(L1/10)+10^(L2/10)) gives 63.0103 dB. Applicability: Uncorrelated sources with the same band, duration and weighting.

title: 污水處理廠臭氣生物濾床
summary: 本課以「把污水臭氣收集、傳質、生物反應與床層維護串成完整流程」為主軸，依序處理臭味源與收集邊界、入口濃度與污染負荷、生物膜傳質與反應、消除容量與去除百分比、變動負荷與重新評估。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Connect wastewater odour collection, mass transfer, biodegradation and bed maintenance, progressing through Odour sources and collection boundary, Inlet concentration and contaminant loading, Biofilm mass transfer and reaction, Elimination capacity and percent removal, Variable loading and reassessment. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 臭味源與收集邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Odour sources and collection boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 臭味源與收集邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Odour sources and collection boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在進水、污泥儲存與脫水區分別標記臭氣源，先確認是否有效收集再討論末端處理率。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。
steps.instructionEn: Mark odour sources at inlet works, sludge storage and dewatering and establish capture before interpreting downstream removal. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
steps.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「臭味源與收集邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Odour sources and collection boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「臭味源與收集邊界」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。

steps.title: 集氣管與抽風需求：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Collection ducts and blower demand: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 集氣管與抽風需求 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 分開罩口、管路與床層壓降，風量過少可能漏收，過大則增加負荷與耗能。 風機軸功率近似流量乘壓升再除效率；阻力增加時不能假設風量與效率都不受影響。
steps.instructionEn: Separate hood, duct and bed pressure losses; low flow may lose capture while excessive flow adds load and energy. Fan shaft power is approximately flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency; increasing resistance may also change flow and efficiency.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：風量 Q=1.5 m³/s；壓升 Δp=1200 Pa；假設效率 η=0.60。公式 P=Q*dp/eta/1000，計算得 3 kW。適用邊界：不可壓縮、固定效率的比較，不是風機曲線選型。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Airflow Q=1.5 m³/s; pressure rise Δp=1200 Pa; assumed efficiency η=0.60. Formula P=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives 3 kW. Applicability: An incompressible fixed-efficiency comparison, not fan-curve selection.

steps.title: 入口濃度與污染負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Inlet concentration and contaminant loading: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 入口濃度與污染負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Inlet concentration and contaminant loading and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 依物種配對氣量與濃度，臭味感受不能直接由單一化合物的質量濃度完整描述。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。
steps.instructionEn: Pair species-specific concentration with flow; one compound mass concentration cannot fully describe perceived odour. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
steps.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「入口濃度與污染負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Inlet concentration and contaminant loading flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「入口濃度與污染負荷」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Inlet concentration and contaminant loading, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 空床停留時間：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Empty-bed residence time: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 空床停留時間 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Empty-bed residence time and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先以總床體積計算 EBRT，再檢查氣體是否均勻穿床；它不等於每個分子的實際孔隙時間。 空床停留時間用總床體積與氣量定義，與實際孔隙停留時間不同。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate EBRT from total bed volume, then check flow distribution; it does not equal every molecule’s actual pore residence. Empty-bed residence time uses total bed volume and flow and differs from actual pore-gas residence.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：空床體積 V=60 m³；氣量 Q=3600 m³/h。公式 EBRT=V/Q*3600，計算得 60 s。適用邊界：平均氣流與固定床體積，不包含孔隙率、短流或反應動力學。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Empty-bed volume V=60 m³; gas flow Q=3600 m³/h. Formula EBRT=V/Q*3600 gives 60 s. Applicability: Mean gas flow and fixed bed volume without porosity, bypass or kinetics.
steps.failure: 平均 EBRT 足夠仍可能因短流讓部分氣體未被處理。 在「空床停留時間」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Adequate mean EBRT can coexist with untreated gas short-circuiting. Mark where this error can enter the Empty-bed residence time flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「空床停留時間」，量各分區氣量、壓降和水分，檢查是否有未利用床區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Empty-bed residence time, Measure zone flows, pressure drops and moisture to identify unused bed regions. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 生物膜傳質與反應：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Biofilm mass transfer and reaction: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 生物膜傳質與反應 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Biofilm mass transfer and reaction and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染物先由氣相移入濕潤生物膜再被利用，教學衰減常數整合多重作用，不能直接視為單一菌種速率。 一階模型讓轉換速率與當下濃度成正比，對數濃度對時間近直線。
steps.instructionEn: Contaminants transfer from gas into moist biofilm before utilization; a teaching decay constant combines effects and is not a species-specific rate. A first-order model makes conversion rate proportional to current concentration; log concentration is approximately linear in time.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Initial C0=100 mg/L; assumed first-order rate k=0.10 d⁻¹; time t=10 d. Formula C=C0*exp(-k*t) gives 36.7879 mg/L. Applicability: Constant environment and availability with no new source; this does not predict a real completion date.
steps.failure: 吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「生物膜傳質與反應」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Biofilm mass transfer and reaction flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「生物膜傳質與反應」，用多時點數據擬合並保留未參與擬合的點，檢查尾端是否偏離一階趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Biofilm mass transfer and reaction, Fit multiple time points, hold some out and inspect late-time deviations from first-order behaviour. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 水分與床材條件：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Moisture and packing condition: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 水分與床材條件 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Moisture and packing condition and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 床材太乾會限制生物作用，太濕可能堵塞孔隙；用濕乾質量記帳，不由單一平均值決定全床狀態。 水和乾固體分別守恆；濕基含水率以總濕重作分母，乾固體重量才能跨不同含水狀態比較。
steps.instructionEn: Dry packing can limit biology while wet packing can obstruct pores; track wet and dry mass rather than inferring the whole bed from one mean. Track water and dry solids separately; wet-basis moisture uses total wet mass as denominator and dry mass permits comparison across moisture states.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕樣總重 mw=1000 kg；濕基含水率 w=0.30。公式 md=mw*(1-w)，計算得 700 kg dry solids。適用邊界：批次代表性樣本，乾燥減重視為水；揮發性物質或結晶水可能使此假設失效。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet sample mass mw=1000 kg; wet-basis moisture w=0.30. Formula md=mw*(1-w) gives 700 kg dry solids. Applicability: A representative batch sample with drying loss treated as water; volatile matter or bound water may invalidate the assumption.
steps.failure: 用濕重比較處理前後會把脫水誤認為固體去除。 在「水分與床材條件」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Comparing wet masses can mistake dewatering for solids removal. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture and packing condition flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「水分與床材條件」，保存稱重、乾燥方法及分樣紀錄，對比重複樣並檢查非水揮發損失。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Moisture and packing condition, Retain weighing, drying method and subsampling records and compare duplicates while checking non-water volatile loss. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 消除容量與去除百分比：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Elimination capacity and percent removal: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 消除容量與去除百分比 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Elimination capacity and percent removal and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 同時比較每床體積移除量與去除比例，判讀低濃度高去除率是否具有足夠負荷能力。 消除容量是每單位床體積每小時移除的質量，和百分比去除率回答不同問題。
steps.instructionEn: Compare removal per bed volume with percentage removal to assess whether high removal at low concentration demonstrates sufficient capacity. Elimination capacity is mass removed per bed volume per hour and answers a different question from percentage removal.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：氣量 Q=1000 m³/h；入口 Cin=50 mg/m³；出口 Cout=10 mg/m³；床 V=20 m³。公式 EC=Q*(Cin-Cout)/V/1000，計算得 2 g/(m³ bed·h)。適用邊界：同一化合物與氣體基準、穩態；不能以單一化合物代表整體嗅覺反應。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Gas Q=1000 m³/h; inlet Cin=50 mg/m³; outlet Cout=10 mg/m³; bed V=20 m³. Formula EC=Q*(Cin-Cout)/V/1000 gives 2 g/(m³ bed·h). Applicability: Same compound and gas basis at steady state; one compound does not represent total perceived odour.
steps.failure: 低進料濃度時高去除率不一定代表高處理負荷能力。 在「消除容量與去除百分比」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: High percentage removal at low inlet concentration does not establish high loading capacity. Mark where this error can enter the Elimination capacity and percent removal flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「消除容量與去除百分比」，同時量入口出口與氣量，並保存其他臭味物種及嗅覺評估的範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。

steps.title: 變動負荷與重新評估：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Variable loading and reassessment: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 變動負荷與重新評估 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Variable loading and reassessment and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 用暴雨進水或污泥作業的假想尖峰改變負荷，檢查排放質量、床體反應與嗅覺評估是否一致。 消除容量是每單位床體積每小時移除的質量，和百分比去除率回答不同問題。
steps.instructionEn: Apply hypothetical peaks from storm inflow or sludge work and check consistency among emitted mass, bed response and odour assessment. Elimination capacity is mass removed per bed volume per hour and answers a different question from percentage removal.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：氣量 Q=1000 m³/h；入口 Cin=50 mg/m³；出口 Cout=10 mg/m³；床 V=20 m³。公式 EC=Q*(Cin-Cout)/V/1000，計算得 2 g/(m³ bed·h)。適用邊界：同一化合物與氣體基準、穩態；不能以單一化合物代表整體嗅覺反應。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Gas Q=1000 m³/h; inlet Cin=50 mg/m³; outlet Cout=10 mg/m³; bed V=20 m³. Formula EC=Q*(Cin-Cout)/V/1000 gives 2 g/(m³ bed·h). Applicability: Same compound and gas basis at steady state; one compound does not represent total perceived odour.
steps.failure: 低進料濃度時高去除率不一定代表高處理負荷能力。 在「變動負荷與重新評估」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: High percentage removal at low inlet concentration does not establish high loading capacity. Mark where this error can enter the Variable loading and reassessment flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「變動負荷與重新評估」，同時量入口出口與氣量，並保存其他臭味物種及嗅覺評估的範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Variable loading and reassessment, Measure inlet, outlet and flow together and document other odorous species and the scope of odour assessment. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 變動負荷與重新評估

steps.title: 維護紀錄與長期表現：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Maintenance records and long-term performance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 維護紀錄與長期表現 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Maintenance records and long-term performance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把床材更換、加濕故障、風機停機與周界氣味事件對時，設備可用不等於持續達到處理目的。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。
steps.instructionEn: Align packing replacement, moisture faults, blower outages and boundary odour events; equipment availability does not establish continuous treatment performance. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總計畫時數 T=1000 h；停機 t=60 h。公式 availability=(T-t)/T*100，計算得 94 %。適用邊界：明確定義計畫時間與停機分類；未納入性能降額或品質不合格。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.
steps.failure: 設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「維護紀錄與長期表現」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。

steps.check: 針對「維護紀錄與長期表現」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.

title: 資源回收設施生命週期評估
summary: 本課以「用功能單位、物料收支與替代情境比較資源回收生命週期」為主軸，依序處理決策目的與功能單位、合格產出與品質差異、運輸噸公里與回程、替代生產與避免負荷、情境敏感度與排序反轉。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Compare recycling lifecycles through functional units, material balances and substitution scenarios, progressing through Decision purpose and functional unit, Qualified output and quality differences, Transport tonne-kilometres and return trips, Displaced production and avoided burden, Scenario sensitivity and ranking reversal. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 決策目的與功能單位：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Decision purpose and functional unit: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 決策目的與功能單位 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Decision purpose and functional unit and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先決定比較一噸廢棄物處理服務，還是一噸符合品質的再生材料，兩者分母不同不能混用。 功能單位決定分母；按投入計算與按合格產品計算會因損失率而不同。
steps.instructionEn: First choose between one tonne of waste-treatment service and one tonne of qualified recycled material; their denominators cannot be mixed. The functional unit sets the denominator; input-based and qualified-product-based values differ with losses.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：每噸投入耗電 E=120 kWh；合格產出率 y=0.75 t/t。公式 Eproduct=E/y，計算得 160 kWh/t qualified output。適用邊界：單一產品且固定投入能耗，未分配其他副產品；不是產品效能完全等價的證明。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Electricity per input tonne E=120 kWh; qualified yield y=0.75 t/t. Formula Eproduct=E/y gives 160 kWh/t qualified output. Applicability: One product and fixed input energy, without coproduct allocation; this does not prove equivalent product performance.
steps.failure: 比較不同分母的數值會使低產率程序看似省能。 在「決策目的與功能單位」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Comparing different denominators can make a low-yield process appear efficient. Mark where this error can enter the Decision purpose and functional unit flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「決策目的與功能單位」，量合格品、次品與殘渣，明確寫出比較是廢棄物處理服務還是材料供應服務。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Decision purpose and functional unit, Measure qualified output, rejects and residues and specify whether comparison concerns waste-treatment or material-supply service. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 邊界、清單與回收率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Boundary, inventory and recovery yield: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 邊界、清單與回收率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Boundary, inventory and recovery yield and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 畫出收運、分類、再加工和殘渣出口，保存進料成分與回收率，避免把所有進料都視為再生品。 回收率衡量原料目標物有多少進入產品；純度則看產品中有多少是目標物，兩者不同。
steps.instructionEn: Map collection, sorting, reprocessing and residue outlets and retain composition and recovery yield instead of treating all input as product. Recovery measures how much feed target reaches product; purity measures target fraction within product. They differ.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：進料 m=1000 kg；目標金屬分率 x=0.08；分選回收率 r=0.75。公式 m_metal=m*x*r，計算得 60 kg。適用邊界：已知原料成分、單一分選步驟；未計附著物或後續精製。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Feed m=1000 kg; target metal fraction x=0.08; separation recovery r=0.75. Formula m_metal=m*x*r gives 60 kg. Applicability: Known feed composition and one separator; adhering material and downstream refining are excluded.
steps.failure: 提高產品總重量可能只是混入更多非金屬。 在「邊界、清單與回收率」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A heavier product may merely contain more non-metal contamination. Mark where this error can enter the Boundary, inventory and recovery yield flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「邊界、清單與回收率」，對進料、產品及尾料分別秤重化驗，求回收率與純度並關閉金屬收支。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Boundary, inventory and recovery yield, Weigh and assay feed, product and tailings; calculate recovery and purity and close the metal balance. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 合格產出與品質差異：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Qualified output and quality differences: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 合格產出與品質差異 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Qualified output and quality differences and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 低純度再生料可能不能一比一替代原生料，合格率與材料功能需獨立驗證。 功能單位決定分母；按投入計算與按合格產品計算會因損失率而不同。
steps.instructionEn: Low-purity recycled material may not displace virgin material one-for-one; qualified yield and material function need separate verification. The functional unit sets the denominator; input-based and qualified-product-based values differ with losses.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：每噸投入耗電 E=120 kWh；合格產出率 y=0.75 t/t。公式 Eproduct=E/y，計算得 160 kWh/t qualified output。適用邊界：單一產品且固定投入能耗，未分配其他副產品；不是產品效能完全等價的證明。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Electricity per input tonne E=120 kWh; qualified yield y=0.75 t/t. Formula Eproduct=E/y gives 160 kWh/t qualified output. Applicability: One product and fixed input energy, without coproduct allocation; this does not prove equivalent product performance.
steps.failure: 比較不同分母的數值會使低產率程序看似省能。 在「合格產出與品質差異」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Comparing different denominators can make a low-yield process appear efficient. Mark where this error can enter the Qualified output and quality differences flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「合格產出與品質差異」，量合格品、次品與殘渣，明確寫出比較是廢棄物處理服務還是材料供應服務。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Qualified output and quality differences, Measure qualified output, rejects and residues and specify whether comparison concerns waste-treatment or material-supply service. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.text: 只將 y 改成 0.60 t/t，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 160 變成 200 kWh/t qualified output。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。

steps.title: 運輸噸公里與回程：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Transport tonne-kilometres and return trips: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 運輸噸公里與回程 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Transport tonne-kilometres and return trips and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 追蹤原料、再生品和殘渣的運輸路徑，將空車回程放在一致邊界中避免遺漏或重算。 噸公里乘係數建立運輸清單，載重、空車回程與運具須在係數或活動量中一致處理。
steps.instructionEn: Track transport of inputs, products and residues and handle empty returns consistently to avoid omission or duplication. Tonne-kilometres multiplied by a factor create transport inventory; payload, empty return and mode must be handled consistently.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：運輸質量 m=1 t；距離 d=80 km；假想係數 f=0.08 kg CO₂e/(t·km)。公式 I=m*d*f，計算得 6.4 kg CO₂e。適用邊界：係數完全是假設，不對應實際車隊；未另計入已包含於係數的活動以免重複。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Transport mass m=1 t; distance d=80 km; hypothetical factor f=0.08 kg CO₂e/(t·km). Formula I=m*d*f gives 6.4 kg CO₂e. Applicability: The factor is hypothetical and represents no actual fleet; do not separately count activities already included in it.
steps.failure: 把一噸投入與一噸合格產出視為同一功能單位會忽略損失。 在「運輸噸公里與回程」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Equating one tonne input with one tonne qualified output ignores losses. Mark where this error can enter the Transport tonne-kilometres and return trips flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「運輸噸公里與回程」，記錄重量、路程、運具與回程邊界，檢查 t、kg、km 的換算。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Transport tonne-kilometres and return trips, Record mass, distance, mode and return-trip boundary and verify t, kg and km conversions. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 替代生產與避免負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Displaced production and avoided burden: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 替代生產與避免負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Displaced production and avoided burden and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把實際處理負荷與假設替代信用分欄，再比較基準情境；負淨值不代表廠房沒有排放。 系統擴張將避免的替代生產列為信用；負值代表相對基準的淨減量，並非沒有排放。
steps.instructionEn: Separate physical treatment burdens from assumed displacement credits before baseline comparison; negative net impact does not mean a plant emits nothing. System expansion credits avoided production; a negative result means reduction relative to a baseline, not absence of emissions.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：處理負荷 B=120 kg CO₂e/t；假設替代材料信用 C=180 kg CO₂e/t。公式 net=B-C，計算得 -60 kg CO₂e/t。適用邊界：功能單位相同、替代品質已假定；不是產品碳足跡認證。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Treatment burden B=120 kg CO₂e/t; assumed displaced-material credit C=180 kg CO₂e/t. Formula net=B-C gives -60 kg CO₂e/t. Applicability: Same functional unit and assumed substitution quality; not a certified product footprint.

steps.instruction: 補入不可回收殘渣的處理與損失，透過質量收支檢查有沒有只計好產品而忽略廢棄出口。 分率必須以同一濕基或乾基定義；總質量乘分率才是該成分的質量。
steps.instructionEn: Include treatment of unrecoverable residues and losses and use mass balance to detect product-only accounting that omits waste outlets. Fractions require a consistent wet or dry basis; multiplying total mass by its fraction gives component mass.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總進料 m=1000 kg；目標成分質量分率 f=0.18。公式 m_target=m*f，計算得 180 kg。適用邊界：批次均勻且分樣具代表性；不把質量分率當體積分率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Total feed m=1000 kg; target-component mass fraction f=0.18. Formula m_target=m*f gives 180 kg. Applicability: A homogeneous batch and representative sampling; mass fraction is not volume fraction.

steps.title: 情境敏感度與排序反轉：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Scenario sensitivity and ranking reversal: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 情境敏感度與排序反轉 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Scenario sensitivity and ranking reversal and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 改變替代率、品質和電力條件，辨識哪一個假設會使方案排序改變，而非只報單一最佳數字。 系統擴張將避免的替代生產列為信用；負值代表相對基準的淨減量，並非沒有排放。
steps.instructionEn: Vary displacement, quality and electricity conditions to identify assumptions that reverse rankings rather than reporting one favourable number. System expansion credits avoided production; a negative result means reduction relative to a baseline, not absence of emissions.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：處理負荷 B=120 kg CO₂e/t；假設替代材料信用 C=180 kg CO₂e/t。公式 net=B-C，計算得 -60 kg CO₂e/t。適用邊界：功能單位相同、替代品質已假定；不是產品碳足跡認證。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Treatment burden B=120 kg CO₂e/t; assumed displaced-material credit C=180 kg CO₂e/t. Formula net=B-C gives -60 kg CO₂e/t. Applicability: Same functional unit and assumed substitution quality; not a certified product footprint.
steps.failure: 把信用同時分配給廢棄者和再生品使用者會重複計算。 在「情境敏感度與排序反轉」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Assigning the same credit to both waste producer and recycled-material user double-counts benefits. Mark where this error can enter the Scenario sensitivity and ranking reversal flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「情境敏感度與排序反轉」，把直接排放與信用分欄，改變替代率與回收品質檢查排序是否反轉。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Scenario sensitivity and ranking reversal, Report direct burdens and credits separately and vary substitution and quality to test ranking reversals. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 資料品質與比較結論：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Data quality and comparative interpretation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 資料品質與比較結論 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Data quality and comparative interpretation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把資料版本、邊界、方法及未涵蓋影響交給下一位玩家；本課算例只示範碳清單，不能代表所有環境影響。 活動量乘排放係數給指定邊界的影響，係數需匹配地區、年度與電力方法。
steps.instructionEn: Handoff data versions, boundaries, methods and omitted impacts; these carbon-inventory examples do not represent every environmental impact category. Activity multiplied by a factor gives impact for a specified boundary; factors must match region, year and electricity-accounting method.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：用電 E=200 kWh/t；假設電力排放係數 f=0.4 kg CO₂e/kWh。公式 impact=E*f，計算得 80 kg CO₂e/t。適用邊界：f 是教學假設而非任何國家即時係數；只含用電項。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Electricity E=200 kWh/t; assumed grid factor f=0.4 kg CO₂e/kWh. Formula impact=E*f gives 80 kg CO₂e/t. Applicability: f is a teaching assumption, not a current national factor; only electricity is included.
steps.failure: 把不同年份或系統邊界的係數混用會產生假比較。 在「資料品質與比較結論」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Mixing factors across years or boundaries creates misleading comparisons. Mark where this error can enter the Data quality and comparative interpretation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「資料品質與比較結論」，保存電表邊界、產量與係數版本，對替代電力情境作敏感度分析。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Data quality and comparative interpretation, Record metering boundary, output and factor version; test alternative electricity scenarios. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

針對「資料品質與比較結論」，保存電表邊界、產量與係數版本，對替代電力情境作敏感度分析。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
操作任務：只將 f 改成 0.2 kg CO₂e/kWh，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 80 變成 40 kg CO₂e/t。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
steps.instructionEn:
For Data quality and comparative interpretation, Record metering boundary, output and factor version; test alternative electricity scenarios. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
Action: Change only grid factor f to 0.2 kg CO₂e/kWh, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 80 to 40 kg CO₂e/t. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：用電 E=200 kWh/t；假設電力排放係數 f=0.4 kg CO₂e/kWh。公式 impact=E*f，計算得 80 kg CO₂e/t。適用邊界：f 是教學假設而非任何國家即時係數；只含用電項。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Electricity E=200 kWh/t; assumed grid factor f=0.4 kg CO₂e/kWh. Formula impact=E*f gives 80 kg CO₂e/t. Applicability: f is a teaching assumption, not a current national factor; only electricity is included.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：每噸投入耗電 E=120 kWh；合格產出率 y=0.75 t/t。公式 Eproduct=E/y，計算得 160 kWh/t qualified output。適用邊界：單一產品且固定投入能耗，未分配其他副產品；不是產品效能完全等價的證明。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Electricity per input tonne E=120 kWh; qualified yield y=0.75 t/t. Formula Eproduct=E/y gives 160 kWh/t qualified output. Applicability: One product and fixed input energy, without coproduct allocation; this does not prove equivalent product performance.
